articles.headline: Update: Iran war — Hormuz attack count revised; Katz says a strike decision rests with Trump, as Netanyahu presses for action
articles.summary:
The Hormuz picture worsened in the afternoon. UKMTO has reclassified Sunday's (22 November) warning: three vessels sailing eastbound through the strait were struck at the same time, around 20:50 UTC (21:50 Madrid), and are now counted as three separate incidents (@sentdefender, https://x.com/i/status/2125276448261042466). They are reported to be the Sinokor-owned tankers *Cameroon Prosperity*, *Bahrain Prosperity* and *Romania Prosperity* (https://x.com/i/status/2125287958940946927). Iran says four more tankers exploded after hitting mines east of the strait (Iranian claim; identities not released), and Tehran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority added 26 tugs and offshore support vessels to its "non-compliance list" for servicing US-backed shipping (@visegrad24, https://x.com/i/status/2125259883482357917).

On the political side, Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said Iran is developing chemical weapons, that the IDF and US CENTCOM are preparing for possible strikes and that the decision rests with President Trump; he also claimed Iranian cells inside the US are targeting Trump and his family. Israel's public broadcaster Kan reported that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike "as soon as possible" (The Independent), while Ynet reports a split: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir sees no immediate threat requiring a strike and Mossad director Roman Gofman favours acting sooner; Haaretz's editorial says Netanyahu "keeps finding pretexts for his political survival". Clash Report says Trump administration officials are debating whether to assassinate senior Iranian leaders (unverified; no primary source given). Qatar urged Washington and Tehran to show restraint (Al Jazeera, Euronews). Iran says it has filed lawsuits in US and European courts over alleged war crimes, including a missile strike on a school that killed at least 178 people (Iranian figure via Al Jazeera), and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused the US of "crippling" the OPCW. A Knesset committee approved about NIS 17.3 billion in extra 2026 defence spending (Katz).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a resumed US–Israeli air campaign would hit European energy prices and shipping again, while European courts may now be drawn into the war's legal fallout. The EU has no seat in these decisions.

- **What to watch:** whether Trump authorises strikes; identities of the mined tankers; insurers' response to Iran's expanded list.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125276448261042466), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125226534281629951), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125287958940946927), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125259883482357917), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125262215154377181), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125278131795693957), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125284201293337055), [The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/netanyahu-trump-strike-iran-israel-war-b3089829.html), [Ynet](https://www.ynetnews.com/article/ry4zdsf17e), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125216648634265931), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125265100831387921), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125268275013767641), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125249751910420912), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125281057419522509), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/11/24/irans-fight-for-wartime-redress-moves-from-battlefield-to-us-eu-courts), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125276099177279683), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125240074606448743)

articles.headline: Update: Yemen–Saudi war — PIF tower in Riyadh hit; Jizan damage confirmed by satellite
articles.summary:
A projectile from Yemen hit a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District, identified as the Public Investment Fund (PIF) tower; Saudi state media published a photo of the damage and Saudi Civil Defence reported 11 injured (via Anadolu). @MenchOsint notes that the Saudi-led coalition spokesman admitted a direct hit, without the usual wording about falling debris, that witnesses heard a loud boom without any civil-defence alert, and that it is the third time a tower in the district has been struck.

Sentinel-2 imagery confirms impacts at the Shuqaiq power station and at Jizan port, where a large warehouse was hit (claims first reported in the 14:30 edition). Clash Report says Riyadh has asked the US, the UK, France and others for more interceptors; France 24 reports that Houthi fighters are closing in on Aden. Pro-Houthi accounts report Saudi airstrikes in Sana'a (unverified). Rashad al-Alimi, head of Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council, said government forces can defeat the Houthis and reunify the country. From the CEAFE archive: as early as February 2022, the UAE, then reeling from Houthi attacks, was seeking advanced Israeli radar (Breaking Defense).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** strikes on Saudi energy and financial sites add risk for Red Sea shipping and oil supply on top of the Hormuz crisis, and Gulf partners are now turning to European suppliers, among others, for air defence.

- **What to watch:** Saudi retaliation in Sana'a; whether Riyadh's air-defence warnings failed; replies to the interceptor requests.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125221709959594491), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125246605515182396), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125226020714213871), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125234776877445523), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125251958315327665), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125203525521023420), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125243873962107377), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125272039359676493), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125241941969293408), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125287439363412171), [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2022/02/uae-reeling-from-houthi-attacks-seeking-israeli-advanced-radar-sources/)

articles.headline: Ukraine's war at sea: Putin vows retaliation for attacks on Russian ships
articles.summary:
Vladimir Putin said Russia will retaliate for Ukrainian attacks on its vessels and accused Kyiv of continuing to strike Russian refineries despite a direct request from President Trump (Al Jazeera). Zelensky defended Saturday's drone strike on the Russian cargo ship *Sparta II* in the Gulf of Finland: "We did everything right", he told US media and Bloomberg.

On Libya, Kyiv insists the attack on Russian ships at Benghazi was self-defence (Reuters). Al Jazeera notes that Ukraine is taking its fight against Russia beyond Europe, from Libya to Sudan and Mali.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a strike in the Gulf of Finland and a vow of retaliation bring the maritime war into NATO's northern waters, between EU member states Finland and Estonia.

- **What to watch:** the form of any Russian retaliation; Baltic shipping security.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125260442037834146), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125256040136810872), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125284605649359347), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125276065056870586)

articles.headline: North-eastern and Black Sea flank: Finland summons Russia's ambassador; Romanian disclosure on Neptun Deep
articles.summary:
Finland, an EU member state and NATO member, summoned Russia's ambassador over Moscow's recent actions in Europe, including a violation of Finnish airspace by a Russian military helicopter on Saturday 21 November (@FaytuksNetwork). Former Romanian defence minister Radu Miruță said Russia declared a no-fly zone over the Neptun Deep gas project in Romania's exclusive economic zone on 20 August and threatened to strike Romanian jets; Romania sent an F-16 anyway, which destroyed a naval drone, and Russia did not respond.

In the Mediterranean, Italy's offshore patrol vessel (PPA) *Giovanni delle Bande Nere* intercepted its first ballistic target with Aster 30 missiles (Army Recognition). ItaMilRadar tracked an Italian Air Force P-72A on a SIGINT mission over Bosnia and Herzegovina for EU Operation Althea and a Portuguese P-3 patrolling the central Mediterranean.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Russian pressure is growing around EU energy infrastructure in the Black Sea, and the Aster interception shows European-made ballistic-missile defence at sea.

- **What to watch:** Bucharest's official confirmation of the August episode; Moscow's reply to Helsinki.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125212441328161013), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125227570153082960), [Army Recognition](https://www.armyrecognition.com/news/navy-news/2026/italys-ppa-giovanni-delle-bande-nere-warship-intercepts-first-ballistic-target-with-aster-30-missiles), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125210101384442348), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125274566297616629)

articles.headline: Update: counter-space — Russian nuclear satellite could launch "within 60 days", German report says
articles.summary:
German broadcasters WDR and NDR and the Süddeutsche Zeitung report an early-November intelligence assessment that Russia could launch "within 60 days", by the end of the year, a nuclear-armed satellite dubbed "Sputnik-S", said to have been stored near Moscow for years (Defense News). Asked in Berlin, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said the Alliance will defend "every inch of NATO territory", including "the space element".

Placing nuclear weapons in orbit is banned by the 1967 Outer Space Treaty, to which Russia is a party; a detonation in orbit could disable many satellites and damage power grids through its electromagnetic pulse.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** European military and civil satellites would be exposed; the report ties in with the 2024 US warnings on a Russian nuclear anti-satellite programme.

- **What to watch:** official German and US comment; launches from Plesetsk and Baikonur.

**Sources:** [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/24/russia-may-launch-nuke-laden-satellite-by-years-end-german-report-warns/), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125211904536723929)

articles.headline: Indo-Pacific: PLA Navy group transits the Osumi Strait; Taiwan's submarine on its 26th sea trial
articles.summary:
Japan's Joint Staff Office reports that four PLA Navy ships, the Type 055 destroyer *Lhasa* (102), the Type 052D *Xining* (117), the Type 054A *Yancheng* (546) and a Type 903A replenishment ship, transited the Osumi Strait westbound into the East China Sea on 24 November.

Taiwan's first domestically built submarine, *Hai Kun* (711), left Kaohsiung for its 26th sea trial, including submerged tests.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** routine PLA transits near Japan and Taiwan's push for its own submarines keep the Taiwan Strait, a key route for European trade, at the centre of regional tension.

- **What to watch:** the PLA group's onward route; results of *Hai Kun*'s submerged trials.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125279026105262325), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125263286312558801)

articles.headline: US: Golden Dome and the "Trump battleship" in the funding stopgap
articles.summary:
The White House is seeking funding exemptions for the Golden Dome missile-defence programme and the planned battleship in the next stopgap budget (Breaking Defense).

US Representative Thomas Massie separately criticised talk of a "$350 billion emergency military supplemental" for Gaza and Iran.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Washington protects its own flagship defence programmes even under stopgap budgets, while Europeans still debate how to fund theirs.

- **What to watch:** whether Congress grants the exemptions in the next continuing resolution.

**Sources:** [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/11/white-house-seeks-funding-exemptions-for-golden-dome-trump-battleship-in-next-funding-stopgap/), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125221943767179707)

articles.headline: Update: Iran war — more tanker fires in Hormuz, bulk carrier hit off the UAE; Tehran orders a tighter blockade
articles.summary:
Iran says two more oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz; Al Jazeera notes the claims have not been independently verified (https://x.com/i/status/2125161737288548511). The IRGC Navy speaks of a fourth “violating” tanker on fire (via https://x.com/i/status/2125186466922004933), and satellite fire detections support at least one ship fire overnight and another in the morning (satellite fire detections). UKMTO separately reports a bulk carrier hit by an unknown projectile at anchor 23 nautical miles north-east of Khor Fakkan (https://x.com/i/status/2125146633188806713). According to Iranian reports, the chief of the regular army (Artesh) ordered the navy commander to tighten the blockade of the strait “day by day” until Washington accepts Tehran’s terms (@IranObserver0, https://x.com/i/status/2125174346972889596). Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said a land blockade of Iran is “virtually impossible” given its size (Iranian state media via Al Jazeera, https://x.com/i/status/2125157475120759287). Despite this, oil fell to three-month lows as rising supply offsets the Hormuz threat (Reuters, https://x.com/i/status/2125191480377561326). On the cyber front, the US Coast Guard has deployed cyber teams after attacks on up to 50 energy tankers (@ClashReport, https://x.com/i/status/2125157229712060513).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** the threat now reaches ships waiting off the UAE, outside the strait itself, raising insurance and freight costs for Europe’s energy imports.

- **Follow-up:** UKMTO details on the Khor Fakkan vessel; names and flags of the burning tankers; any US response to the blockade order.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125161737288548511), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125186466922004933), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125146633188806713), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125174346972889596), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125157475120759287), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125191480377561326), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125157229712060513)

articles.headline: Ukraine war: 355 drones toward Moscow; Russian strikes kill 9; Western parts in Russian drones
articles.summary:
Moscow mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 355 drones flew towards the capital between 23:00 on 23 November and 08:00 on 24 November (relayed via https://x.com/i/status/2125172938185789689); Russia’s Defence Ministry claims 699 Ukrainian drones were shot down overnight over Russian regions and the Black Sea (claim relayed via https://x.com/i/status/2125126375313215925). Russian attacks killed 9 people and injured 77 across Ukraine over the past day; in Zaporizhzhia Oblast a five-storey residential building was partly destroyed, killing two and injuring 44 (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125194936035238171), and Zelensky said Russian strikes focused on energy in the Zhytomyr region (reposted by @F_CEAFE). A Ukrainian intelligence report seen by the Kyiv Independent finds US and European components in a Geran-4 jet drone shot down in August; 12 parts carry dates, all made in 2024–2026 (https://x.com/i/status/2125130441258684535). @OSINTtechnical shows the R-280 highway, a key Russian supply route in the occupied south, littered with destroyed trucks (https://x.com/i/status/2125175908038254835). A Guardian analysis of leaked Rosstat records lists 1,087 Russian military suicides since the start of the Ukraine war (@ClashReport, https://x.com/i/status/2125171316638753135).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** European components still reach Russian drones despite sanctions, a sanctions-enforcement issue for the EU.

- **Follow-up:** damage assessment around Moscow; the new EU sanctions package (topic 6).

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125172938185789689), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125126375313215925), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125194936035238171), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125130441258684535), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125175908038254835), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125171316638753135)

articles.headline: North-eastern flank: Geran-5 in Poland, Russian build-up near Finland, Sarmat
articles.summary:
The drone that entered Poland on the night of 23–24 November is now described by independent analysts as a jet-powered Geran-5 that reached about 25 km into Polish territory (Update; https://x.com/i/status/2125131447254106462). Yle reports Russia is modernising a base near the Finnish border for up to 11,000 troops (https://x.com/i/status/2125172958024835478), and Latvia is reportedly considering closing its border with Russia (unverified, https://x.com/i/status/2125125375529287688). IISS says the Sarmat heavy ICBM may have begun entering service (https://x.com/i/status/2125152951849070740). NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte called on member states to prepare society as a whole for the risk of war with Russia (relayed via https://x.com/i/status/2125184097974628762).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** jet drones are faster and harder to intercept than Shaheds; the Finnish-border build-up will define NATO’s newest front.

- **Follow-up:** Polish debris or radar data; Finnish Defence Forces comment on the Yle report.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125131447254106462), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125172958024835478), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125125375529287688), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125152951849070740), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125184097974628762)

articles.headline: Update: Libya — Kyiv calls the Benghazi strikes self-defence; imagery confirms the *Angara*
articles.summary:
Ukraine’s Foreign Ministry spokesman Heorhii Tykhyi said the strikes on Russian ships in Libya were lawful self-defence, arguing that “the threat to Libya was created precisely by Russian warships and Russian arms carriers” (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125185563741295039). OSINT imagery confirms the cargo ship hit near Benghazi was the Ro-Ro *Angara* (via @FaytuksNetwork, https://x.com/i/status/2125166566157562165). Libyan authorities condemned the attacks (CGTN, state media, https://x.com/i/status/2125122246595207224). Unverified aggregator claims say an Iranian vessel, *Alvan*, was also hit by naval drones off Libya (https://x.com/i/status/2125127769466040334), and that Albania denied drones were launched from its territory (https://x.com/i/status/2125126659418554801).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** the naval war now touches the central Mediterranean, Libya’s politics and, through rumours, NATO members such as Albania.

- **Follow-up:** confirmation or denial of the *Alvan* report; Tripoli and LNA positions.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125185563741295039), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125166566157562165), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125122246595207224), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125127769466040334), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125126659418554801)

articles.headline: Yemen–Saudi war: Houthis claim 11th Wing Loong-2; UK sanctions

Yemen’s Ansarallah (Houthis) say they shot down another Saudi-operated Wing Loong-2 drone over Lahj governorate, the eleventh since the escalation began (@MenchOsint, https://x.com/i/status/2125154806079594778). Pro-Houthi accounts claim damage at the Shuqaiq power station in Jizan after a Yemeni attack (via https://x.com/i/status/2125198550522806468). Both are unverified, partisan claims. The UK announced sanctions on the Houthis for undermining stability in the Middle East and on four senior officials over human rights abuses (via @FaytuksNetwork, https://x.com/i/status/2125193504695705936).

- **Follow-up:** Saudi confirmation; damage at Shuqaiq, a major power and desalination site.

articles.headline: Update: Iran war — IRGC says three tankers under US escort hit mines in Hormuz; Iran vows “all tools” against the blockade
articles.summary:
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says three “non-compliant” oil tankers sailing under US aerial escort suffered “severe explosions and fire” after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz; the Iranian Navy said the US escort “was unable to prevent these incidents” and promised images (Al Jazeera). These are Iranian claims; no US confirmation was found in the window. Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said Iran will use “all the tools” at its disposal against the US naval blockade, which it calls aggression, while Tehran also said security in the strait could be restored quickly if the US met its conditions. On the diplomatic track, Axios reports that Vice President JD Vance met Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani on the Iran negotiations, and Qatar says it continues to work on de-escalation. Separately, the WSJ reports that the US is investigating cyberattacks on up to 50 ships, some with bomb threats, with Iran and Russia as possible suspects; the US says it has no evidence of Iranian involvement (Reuters; Al Jazeera). The IRGC also says it has shot down its 58th MQ-9.

**Context:** Antecedentes: the Strait of Hormuz has been blockaded since the spring of 2026; on 17 April 2026 @F_CEAFE commented on President Emmanuel Macron's announcement that France, alongside more than fifty countries, was leading an initiative for freedom of navigation in the strait ([X, 2026](https://x.com/i/status/2045202134480638071)).

**What to watch:** US confirmation or denial of the mine hits; tanker names and flags; UKMTO advisories.

**Sources:** [X (1)](https://x.com/i/status/2124984786498281551), [X (2)](https://x.com/i/status/2125080719227494502), [X (3)](https://x.com/i/status/2124983403749466497), [X (4)](https://x.com/i/status/2124994660905218223), [X (5)](https://x.com/i/status/2125026612714319920), [X (6)](https://x.com/i/status/2125004055013392481), [X (7)](https://x.com/i/status/2125050893733154952), [X (8)](https://x.com/i/status/2125082018589368516), [X (9)](https://x.com/i/status/2125088850083295612), [X (10)](https://x.com/i/status/2125018031248347478)
articles.why: mines and cyberattacks on merchant shipping raise insurance and energy costs for Europe and test whether escorts alone can keep the strait open.

articles.headline: Poland and Moldova: Russian drone violates Polish airspace days after missile incursion
articles.summary:
A Russian one-way attack drone briefly entered Polish airspace during the overnight attack on western Ukraine; Polish air defence was activated and air-raid sirens sounded near Lublin (@visegrad24). It follows the Kh-101 debris found at three Polish sites last week. In Moldova, local media report a drone burst into flames after crashing in the Russian-occupied Transnistria region on the evening of 23 November (Kyiv Independent).

**What to watch:** Polish government statement on debris; any NATO Article 4 request; confirmation of AWACS forward deployment.

**Sources:** [X (1)](https://x.com/i/status/2124991594957009253), [X (2)](https://x.com/i/status/2125003063308251529), [X (3)](https://x.com/i/status/2125058619175510306)
articles.why: repeated incursions test NATO’s eastern air defence and its rules of engagement.

articles.headline: Russian warplanes near Ulleung: South Korea orders residents to shelter and scrambles F-15Ks; Seoul will protest to Moscow
articles.summary:
At 07:52 local time on Tuesday (23:52 Madrid on Monday), South Korea's interior ministry ordered residents of Ulleung island to take shelter underground after several Russian military aircraft entered the Korea Air Defence Identification Zone (KADIZ) over the East Sea (Sea of Japan). The alert was lifted about five minutes later. The Joint Chiefs of Staff said the aircraft came "to the point just before violating" the island's airspace and then left; there was no violation. F-15Ks were scrambled before the aircraft entered the zone. A provincial message wrongly called them "suspected North Korean aircraft" and was corrected later. The defence ministry will summon a Russian embassy official to lodge a formal complaint (Yonhap, JoongAng Daily, The Guardian). In Brussels the previous week, Japan's State Minister of Defence Odawara told the EU Schuman Security and Defence Forum that Euro-Atlantic and Indo-Pacific security are "inseparable".

**What to watch:** Russia's response to Seoul's protest; any joint Russia–China air patrol pattern (previous ones have crossed the KADIZ); Japanese reports of the same flight.

**Sources:** [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002251315), [Korea JoongAng Daily](https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/korea/russian-aircraft-prompt-brief-ulleung-air-raid-warning-alert-mistakenly-identifies-them-as-north-korean/12987159), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/south-korea-tells-island-residents-to-take-shelter-after-russian-military-aircraft-approach), [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2125074478786846973), [dpa](https://x.com/i/status/2125103119046426829), [Japan MoD (Odawara at the Schuman Forum)](https://x.com/i/status/2125098507589779512)
articles.why: the pattern of Russian probes now runs from Poland and the Baltic to the Korean peninsula. The same pressure on air-defence systems and public nerves that Poland, Finland and Estonia faced last week now appears on the far side of Eurasia. It reinforces the case for Europe to build its own airspace-surveillance and air-defence capabilities, rather than relying on others' alert systems.

articles.headline: Yemen–Saudi war: launches from Yemen toward southern Saudi Arabia
articles.summary:
**Pro-Houthi accounts report missile and drone launches from Yemen with Saudi air defences active in the south, and flights to Jeddah and Dammam placed in holding patterns (@MenchOsint; video via). The same accounts accuse Saudi Arabia of new strikes on civilians in Yemen. These are unverified, partisan sources; no Saudi official confirmation was found in the window.**

**What to watch:** Saudi coalition statement; GACA flight notices.

**Sources:** [X (1)](https://x.com/i/status/2124964288821436526), [X (2)](https://x.com/i/status/2124989938844246140), [X (3)](https://x.com/i/status/2124942788638781675)

articles.headline: Update: Benghazi: Zelensky says seven naval drones sank the *Merkury*; unconfirmed reports on Misrata and an Iranian ship
articles.summary:
**President Volodymyr Zelensky said seven naval drones were used in the attack that sank the Russian Steregushchiy-class corvette *Merkury* in Benghazi (Defense News; Reuters; Navy Recognition).**

OSINT researchers traced the ro-ro *Angara* (IMO 9179842), also hit in Benghazi, to a departure from St Petersburg on 26 October. ItaMilRadar called 22 November possibly the worst day for the Russian Navy in the Mediterranean in more than a century. Al Jazeera published an explainer on fears that the war is spreading after the strikes on two Russian vessels off Libya. Two further reports remain unconfirmed. An X account says Ukraine uses the Air Force Academy at Misrata, in western Libya under the Tripoli-based Government of National Unity, to launch attacks on Russian assets; it says the presence began in 2023 "under an arrangement with Turkey". Another account says naval drones set the stern of the Iranian cargo ship *ALVAN* on fire at Benghazi. Tracking sites report that an IRISL-operated *ALVAN* was hit on 22 November and stayed afloat. Kyiv has not claimed it, and no Libyan, Turkish, Italian or Iranian official confirmation was found. OSINT accounts also report a second Russian Ro-Ro convoy slowing off Tunisia (not confirmed).

**Context:** on 23 November Zelensky called the Benghazi strike "an exemplary Ukrainian operation" by the SBU and the Defence Forces ([Zelensky](https://x.com/i/status/2124764825049850041)); the 14:30 edition reported Albania's denial of any role. Two RAF P-8 Poseidon aircraft flew from Sigonella over the Ionian Sea last week (ItaMilRadar).

**What to watch:** Russian convoy routing via Tunisia; LNA and Russian responses; Iranian statements on the *ALVAN*; Italian, Turkish and EU comments on Misrata.

**Sources:** [Defense News](https://x.com/i/status/2124888774949613608), [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2124885684200833169), [Navy Recognition](https://x.com/i/status/2124857763864141899), [OSINT on Angara](https://x.com/i/status/2124916429015453807), [ItaMilRadar](https://x.com/i/status/2124921139348808092), [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124891975836901695), [Misrata report (@AmirJafar0)](https://x.com/i/status/2124801903557243310), [ALVAN report (@HormuzReport)](https://x.com/i/status/2124877580537040932), [Monitor the Situation](https://monitor-the-situation.com/middle-east/reported-iranian-cargo-ship-alvan-203c01e9), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya), [Tunisia convoy (OSINT)](https://x.com/i/status/2124916497319334122), [ItaMilRadar (P-8)](https://x.com/i/status/2124895579440320759)
articles.why: a naval front in the central Mediterranean, south of Italy and Malta, both EU member states, puts EU shipping and Libya's balance of power directly in play.

articles.headline: Ukraine war: daylight drone attacks in central Kyiv; Dymer toll rises to 11
articles.summary:
**Russian drones struck near the Ukrainian presidential office and the Maidan in central Kyiv in daylight, with fire and black smoke at the scene (Christopher Miller; Fabrice Deprez).**

In Dymer, rescuers were still searching the rubble of a five-storey building hit by a Russian drone; at least 11 people were killed (Al Jazeera). A Ukrainian Air Force Mirage 2000-5F was filmed shooting down a Russian jet-powered attack drone with its 30 mm cannon. Russian sources relayed a Russian Defence Ministry claim that 87 Ukrainian drones were downed between 08:00 and 20:00 Moscow time (state claim, not verified). A new Mediazona/Meduza estimate puts Russian soldiers killed at more than 700,000. Kyiv Independent reports that Ukraine went almost two weeks without hitting Russian refineries in the second half of October under US pressure, shifting to airfields and missile-production plants.

**Context:** the 14:30 edition reported that the Novoshakhtinsk refinery halted operations after a six-hour attack, and four people killed by Russian attacks across Ukraine over the previous day.

**What to watch:** damage assessments in central Kyiv; the final Dymer toll; further Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries.

**Sources:** [Christopher Miller](https://x.com/i/status/2124868686641340718), [Fabrice Deprez](https://x.com/i/status/2124879237106598297), [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124899525269803440), [Mirage 2000-5F video](https://x.com/i/status/2124913506244026423), [Russian MoD claim](https://x.com/i/status/2124925311699587381), [Mediazona/Meduza](https://x.com/i/status/2124909918863974747), [Kyiv Independent](https://x.com/i/status/2124913726096904598)
articles.why: French-built Mirage 2000 jets are now part of Ukraine's defence against jet drones, and the war's toll keeps rising on both sides.

articles.headline: Baltic and Kaliningrad: Russia buys rail ferries; Moscow warns Estonia
articles.summary:
**Russia will spend $576 million on two rail ferries for Kaliningrad, due in service in 2030. Sea freight now carries more than half of the enclave's supplies since Lithuania restricted the transit of sanctioned goods.**

OSINT analysts note Kaliningrad's vulnerability if the Baltic states restrict rail transit or Ukrainian attacks on Russian shipping continue. Russia runs five ferries, mainly on the Ust-Luga–Baltiysk route. Pro-Russian accounts relayed a Russian Foreign Ministry statement that Estonia is "on the brink of an open conflict" with Russia (state claim; original not checked). Reuters trackers report that more than ten tankers have suffered loading delays this month at Russian Baltic and Black Sea oil terminals, because of severe weather and the risk of Ukrainian drone attacks.

*CEAFE:* Here is another example of why Europeans need to act together.

**Context:** in June 2022 Lithuania restricted the rail transit of sanctioned Russian goods to Kaliningrad and President Gitanas Nausėda said Vilnius would not compromise ([TASS](https://x.com/i/status/1541097726582165504)). The 14:30 edition reported the Kremlin's "terrorism" accusation after the drone attack on the *Sparta II*. Lithuania and Estonia are EU member states and NATO members.

**What to watch:** Estonia's response to Moscow's warning; any new transit restrictions; further incidents involving Russian shipping in the Baltic.

**Sources:** [Kaliningrad ferries](https://x.com/i/status/2124891072627097909), [OSINT analysis](https://x.com/i/status/2124922022774128749), [OSINT (ferries)](https://x.com/i/status/2124916207371362393), [Russian MFA on Estonia](https://x.com/i/status/2124919912141373547), [Reuters (tankers)](https://x.com/i/status/2124840897208840227)
articles.why: the Baltic sea lines to Kaliningrad are becoming a new pressure point between NATO and Russia, running through EU waters.

articles.headline: Update: Iran war: Israeli debate over a new strike; Tehran sues Jordan and the GCC
articles.summary:
**Haaretz reports that Mossad research analysts oppose immediate military action against Iran, while Mossad chief Roman Gofman keeps backing a strike.**

Caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned against downplaying "serious and grave threats". Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot said he sees no "immediate threat" from Iran. Iran's top judiciary official said a lawsuit has been filed against Jordan and the GCC countries for helping the US in its war against Iran (relayed by a pro-Iranian account). Reuters commentary notes that oil's recovery from the Iran war masks a stubborn diesel shortage. Al Jazeera reports that US sanctions are blocking Iran's access to medicines.

**Context:** the 14:30 edition reported that the Iranian parliament's National Security Commission said the Majles is ready to pass a bill to leave the NPT ([TASS](https://x.com/i/status/2124821613493305701)), and Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich's remark that Israel has "two years" to act against Iran.

**What to watch:** Israeli cabinet decisions; Iran's lawsuit against Jordan and the GCC; diesel prices in Europe.

**Sources:** [Haaretz](https://x.com/i/status/2124917029400416554), [Netanyahu](https://x.com/i/status/2124902792028442921), [Netanyahu (2)](https://x.com/i/status/2124906997426327843), [Eisenkot](https://x.com/i/status/2124901403181097289), [Iranian judiciary](https://x.com/i/status/2124889018768802213), [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2124880774813872449), [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124880667846811792)
articles.why: a renewed Israeli strike would reach Europe through Hormuz energy flows and diesel prices.

articles.headline: Yemen: Houthi missile aimed at Aden hits Dhamar; Turkey rules out troops
articles.summary:
**Yemeni government forces say a Houthi missile launched from Saada towards Aden struck Dhamar instead. They warn that Houthi ballistic missiles threaten civilians across Yemen (Al Jazeera).**

The Houthi-run Yemeni Armed Forces claim that Saudi F-15s from Khamis Mushait bombed buses and other commercial vehicles (Houthi claim, not verified). Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan reiterated that Ankara is not deploying troops to Saudi Arabia or the Arabian Peninsula.

**Context:** the Yemen–Saudi war has centred on the areas around Aden and Taiz in recent CEAFE editions.

**What to watch:** further Houthi launches towards Aden; Saudi air operations; Türkiye's position.

**Sources:** [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124919656943063307), [Houthi claim](https://x.com/i/status/2124916808087970083), [Hakan Fidan](https://x.com/i/status/2124927846854307931)
articles.why: the war runs alongside the Bab el-Mandeb route between the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, a key passage for shipping to and from EU ports.

articles.headline: Update: Zelensky claims the sinking of the Russian corvette Merkury off Libya; Albania denies any role
articles.summary:
**President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Monday that Ukraine carried out Sunday's attack in Benghazi, calling it "an exemplary Ukrainian operation in response to Russia's war" by the SBU and the Defence Forces.**

Zelensky released footage of the Project 20380 corvette *Merkury* being hit and said the dry-cargo ship *Angara*, which Kyiv says carries weapons, was also struck; "We continue our operations in designated waters" (Zelensky; AP; Defense News). Libyan eastern-based military officials had earlier said six drones approached, four were intercepted and two hit the ship, slightly injuring ten Russian and Libyan personnel (Anadolu). Pro-Russian channels say seven sea drones were used and a Ka-27 helicopter destroyed (not verified). Albania's Foreign Ministry "categorically" rejected reports that the drones were launched from its territory. Speaking to the NATO Parliamentary Assembly, Zelensky said Russia feels Ukraine's response "from western Siberia… to the coast of Libya, where its warships are sinking". The Kremlin's Monday remarks did not mention Libya (TASS).

**Context:** the 08:30 edition reported the sinking, a second drone-boat attack and the UN call for an independent investigation. Albania is an EU candidate country and a NATO member.

**What to watch:** an official Russian response; the identity of the ship hit off Benghazi; reactions from Malta, Italy and the EU; the Libyan complaint at the UN Security Council.

**Sources:** [Zelensky](https://x.com/i/status/2124764825049850041), [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/ukraine-says-it-sank-russian-warship-in-naval-drone-attack-off-libya/4134067), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/mideast-africa/2026/11/23/ukraine-confirms-it-sank-russian-corvette-in-libyan-port/), [AP](https://x.com/i/status/2124837321363054700), [Albanian MFA](https://x.com/i/status/2124771038533665264), [Anadolu (Albania)](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/albania-denies-involvement-in-naval-drone-attack-on-russian-corvette-off-libya/4134177), [Zelensky at NATO PA](https://x.com/i/status/2124813166743883860), [TASS](https://t.me/tassagency_en/99523)
articles.why: the Ukraine war at sea now reaches the central Mediterranean, near EU shipping lanes and Libya's fragile balance between Russia and Türkiye.

articles.headline: Baltic: the Kremlin accuses Ukraine of "terrorism" after the drone attack on the Sparta II; GPS jamming reaches Stockholm
articles.summary:
**The Kremlin accused Ukraine of terrorist acts in the Baltic Sea after a drone attack on the Russian cargo ship *Sparta II* near Finland, and urged the Baltic states to use their influence over Kyiv to stop them (Reuters; TASS).**

Over the weekend the Baltic satellite-navigation jamming area expanded north-west: 40–50% of flights at Stockholm Arlanda were affected over two days, against about 1% before, according to flight-tracking data. In Finland, allied fighters, including French Rafales, are training dispersed road-base operations in Exercise Protective Fence 26.

**Context:** Finland, Sweden and the three Baltic states are EU member states and NATO members. Bulgarian Deputy Prime Minister Atanas Pekanov said on Monday that "escalation in the Black Sea is completely unacceptable" after attacks on cargo ships off Romania and Bulgaria (Euronews).

**What to watch:** details of the *Sparta II* attack; Swedish and Finnish statements on the jamming.

**Sources:** [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2124838985805463584), [TASS](https://t.me/tassagency_en/99523), [Flightradar24 data](https://x.com/i/status/2124788583429288066), [Protective Fence 26](https://x.com/i/status/2124834980413243640), [Armée de l'Air](https://x.com/i/status/2124759839134093562), [Euronews](https://x.com/i/status/2124776937176646004)
articles.why: a Ukraine–Russia naval confrontation in the Baltic runs through EU and NATO waters, and the jamming already affects civil aviation in an EU capital.

articles.headline: Update: Iran war: Tehran's parliament says it is ready to leave the NPT; Hormuz oil exports down about 40% since early November
articles.summary:
**The Iranian parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Commission said the Majles is ready to pass a bill to withdraw from the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) as soon as the Islamic Republic takes that decision (TASS).**

IRGC deputy commander-in-chief Maj. Gen. Mostafa Izadi said Iran would respond to any threat "without geographical limits" (Al Jazeera; IRNA). State broadcaster IRIB quoted Iran's legal-affairs chief as saying several US-linked ships "have just been seized" to enforce $290 billion in domestic court damages (state media claim, not verified). An economist's count says at least seven tankers were struck in the past week and Hormuz oil exports are down about 40% since early November. Iran denied that an IRGC-linked group carried out a cyberattack on French supermarket refrigeration systems. In Israel, Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich said Israel has "two years" to "eliminate the threat of the Iranian regime once and for all" (Clash Report clip; Times of Israel).

**Context:** Trump told Fox News on 22 November he is "inclined" to resume strikes on Iran after the new year if there is no deal (08:30 edition).

**What to watch:** an actual bill in the Majles; the IAEA; US and Israeli statements on resuming strikes.

**Sources:** [TASS](https://x.com/i/status/2124821613493305701), [IRNA](https://x.com/i/status/2124815254836150691), [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124821534267281660), [IRIB](https://x.com/i/status/2124826117026574506), [Hormuz count](https://x.com/i/status/2124834665081024960), [Iran on French cyberattack](https://x.com/i/status/2124803913933328404), [Smotrich (Clash Report)](https://x.com/i/status/2124758165480710605), [Times of Israel](https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/israel-must-go-to-war-against-iran-as-soon-as-all-conditions-allow-says-ex-mossad-chief/)
articles.why: an Iranian NPT withdrawal would hit the non-proliferation regime the EU helped build with the JCPOA; Europe pays the energy and security costs without a say in the decision, and the French cyber accusation brings the war into an EU member state.

articles.headline: Update: Ukraine war: the Novoshakhtinsk refinery halts operations after a six-hour attack
articles.summary:
**The governor of Russia's Rostov region says the Novoshakhtinsk refinery suspended operations after a combined drone and missile attack lasting more than six hours; thick smoke was still rising on Monday morning.**

Citing Reuters, visegrad24 says operations at 15 of Russia's 35 largest refineries had been disrupted or halted by mid-November and daily refining fell by roughly 40–45%. Russian attacks killed four people, including a 15-year-old boy, and injured 19 across Ukraine over the past day (Kyiv Independent).

**Context:** the 08:30 edition reported the overnight strikes on the Novoshakhtinsk and Perm refineries.

**What to watch:** repair time at Novoshakhtinsk; Russian fuel export restrictions.

**Sources:** [Rostov governor](https://x.com/i/status/2124811044925198480), [smoke footage](https://x.com/i/status/2124810877450772869), [visegrad24 (Reuters data)](https://x.com/i/status/2124816805948456963), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/russian-attacks-kill-4-including-15-year-old-boy-injure-19-across-ukraine-over-past-day/), [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2124817780994142663)
articles.why: the refinery campaign strains Russia's war economy, while diesel supply in Europe remains tight (Reuters).

articles.headline: Update: Benghazi: the *Merkury* sinks, a second ship is hit and the UN calls for an independent investigation
articles.summary:
**The Russian corvette *Merkury*, struck in the port of Benghazi on Sunday, has sunk: satellite images from Vantor and those obtained by The War Zone show the Project 20380 ship capsized at the pier with only the bow above water.**

A health official of the eastern Libyan government told Anadolu that 10 port workers were moderately injured in the first attack. Later on Sunday, according to a Libyan military source, explosive-laden drone boats struck a Maltese-flagged cargo ship off Benghazi; its crew was evacuated, and Libyan forces say they destroyed several boats (Arab News, citing military sources, says more than 20 were intercepted). ItaMilRadar and OSINT accounts identify the ship hit offshore as the ro-ro *Ascalon*, part of a Russian military cargo convoy; no official source has confirmed its identity, and Libyan statements only speak of a Maltese vessel.

**Reactions:** the eastern government of Osama Hammad filed a complaint with the UN General Assembly and Security Council, asked for an international investigation and demanded an explanation from Ukraine about its "military activities" in Libya. Libya's House of Representatives rejected any use of Libyan territory or waters for foreign conflicts. The UN Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL) called for an "immediate, independent and transparent investigation" and warned that Libya "must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts". Reuters reports that no one has claimed responsibility; a Ukrainian source told The War Zone that the SBU carried out the strike, while Kyiv has made no official comment. By 07:00 Madrid, the official Russian channels (TASS, MFA, MoD, Kremlin) had published nothing on Benghazi.

**Unconfirmed:** OSINT accounts note that a US "ARTEMIS II" ISTAR aircraft (N159L) flew missions towards the Libyan coast in the days before the attack. A flight pattern is not evidence of involvement, and no official source has confirmed any link.

**Context:** the attack follows the drone strike on the *Sparta II* in the Gulf of Finland on 21 November. With *Boikiy* and *Merkury* out of action, OSINT counts say half of the Baltic Fleet's four operational Project 20380 corvettes are disabled.

**What to watch:** Russia's official version; the ship's identity and flag; Malta's and the EU's reactions; whether the Security Council takes up the Libyan complaint.

**Sources:** [Anadolu](https://v.aa.com.tr/4133874), [Anadolu (UNSMIL)](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/un-warns-libya-must-not-become-a-battleground-for-foreign-conflicts-after-benghazi-attacks/4133896), [Arab News](https://www.arabnews.com/middle-east/un-urges-probe-into-benghazi-attacks-warns-libya-against-becoming-battleground-3013640), [The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/ukraines-campaign-against-russian-naval-assets-far-beyond-the-black-sea-enters-a-new-phase), [AFP](https://x.com/i/status/2124717207166882204), [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2124744758937657851), [ItaMilRadar](https://www.itamilradar.com/), [satellite image](https://x.com/i/status/2124572456396673489), [Emad Badi](https://x.com/i/status/2124524174618120541), [@DefenceGeek](https://x.com/i/status/2124531738357477714)
articles.why: a drone boat hitting a ship under the flag of Malta, an EU member state, brings the Ukraine war into shipping lanes near Italy and Malta in the central Mediterranean. The EU, which runs Operation IRINI off Libya, had issued no statement by 07:00 Madrid. As Libyan analyst Emad Badi wrote, the attacks test the Turkish–Russian balance in Libya.

articles.headline: Ukraine war: overnight drone strikes on the Novoshakhtinsk and Perm refineries and a Tatarstan pumping station
articles.summary:
**Ukrainian drones set fire to the Novoshakhtinsk refinery in Rostov region (about 7.5 million tonnes a year) overnight, according to the Kyiv Independent.**

In the morning, drones reportedly hit the LUKOIL refinery in Perm, and the Kaleykino oil pumping station near Almetyevsk, in Tatarstan, was also reportedly attacked. Russian sources had not confirmed the damage.

**What to watch:** Russian MoD statements; any confirmed damage to refining capacity.

**Sources:** [Kyiv Independent](https://x.com/i/status/2124674348472549608), [@ClashReport](https://x.com/i/status/2124746015093776697), [@sentdefender](https://x.com/i/status/2124662037720494290), [Perm refinery](https://x.com/i/status/2124749095982002683), [Kaleykino](https://x.com/i/status/2124712692984263119)
articles.why: strikes on Russian refining and pipelines add to the risk premium on oil and fuel markets that Europe buys from.

articles.headline: Ukraine war: death toll in Kyiv region strike rises; Odesa left without power
articles.summary:
**The death toll from the Russian strike on an apartment block in Kyiv region rose to six, according to the Kyiv Independent; a seven-year-old boy was pulled alive after 14 hours under the rubble in Dymer.**

Russian attacks left Odesa without power (AFP). A Geran-5 jet drone reportedly hit the railway station in Lyubotyn, Kharkiv region, causing a large fire and casualties (not independently confirmed).

**What to watch:** Ukraine's energy grid as winter begins; *Foreign Affairs* warns this winter could be "the most brutal yet" for Ukraine.

**Sources:** [Kyiv Independent](https://x.com/i/status/2124622931112157629), [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124725922045837642), [AFP](https://x.com/i/status/2124680642067583385), [AFP (Odesa)](https://x.com/i/status/2124731674457940444), [Foreign Affairs](https://x.com/i/status/2124724625632268664)

articles.headline: Update: Iran war: Trump links Iran's attacks to oil prices; Tehran sues in US and European courts
articles.summary:
**In a Truth Social post on Sunday night, Trump wrote that Iran "has launched more drones and missiles in the last week than at any time for over a year" and that "they've all been knocked down, and done no damage".**

He also claimed that Iran had killed "81,000 protestors as of today" (his figure, not independently verified) and blamed the Democrats and Iran for high oil prices. Democrats in Congress plan to use funding to force an end to the US–Israel war on Iran as early as December (Al Jazeera). In Tehran, Vice President for Legal Affairs Majid Ansari said Iran has started legal proceedings in the US and four European countries, not named, over alleged war crimes during the US–Israeli attacks (Anadolu). Iran's IRGC deputy commander says two tankers caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz (Al Jazeera). Bahrain says two people were wounded in Saturday's Iranian strike on a "civilian industrial site" (AFP). Yemen's Houthis claimed an attack on Saudi Arabia's Rabigh refinery (Reuters; Houthi claim).

**What to watch:** which European courts receive the complaints; any US move to resume strikes; Saudi confirmation of damage at Rabigh.

**Sources:** [Truth Social](https://truthsocial.com/@realDonaldTrump/117662290160182921), [Anadolu](https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-files-war-crime-lawsuits-in-american-european-courts-over-us-israeli-attacks/4133788), [Al Jazeera (Congress)](https://x.com/i/status/2124655417347166603), [Al Jazeera (Hormuz)](https://x.com/i/status/2124660802301067277), [AFP (Bahrain)](https://x.com/i/status/2124597573117722764), [Reuters (Houthis)](https://x.com/i/status/2124588778505343239)
articles.why: four European countries are set to become venues for Iran's lawsuits, while every incident in Hormuz and the Red Sea raises Europe's energy bill (see Economy).

articles.headline: Russian corvette *Merkury* struck in Benghazi: the Ukraine war reaches the Mediterranean
articles.summary:
**A Russian Navy corvette moored at the Benghazi naval base in eastern Libya was hit by an explosion before dawn on Sunday and caught fire; naval analyst H I Sutton provisionally identified it as the *Merkury*, a Project 20380 (Steregushchiy-class) corvette commissioned in 2023, and assessed it as "almost certainly destroyed".**

The eastern Libyan government of Osama Hammad, backed by Khalifa Haftar, said the explosion occurred aboard a Russian ship that was "on its way back to Russia" and had stopped to refuel, that it was most likely an attack "using unmanned vehicles", and ordered a joint inquiry with Russia. Two Libyan military officials told AP that, according to an initial investigation, several Ukrainian sea drones were launched from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya. Satellite images published by the Telegram channel Strategic Aviation and reported by Militarnyi show fire across the stern and part of the midsection; by the afternoon OSINT accounts said the ship had sunk after at least two naval drones hit it. In the evening, unmanned surface vessels were filmed striking at least one Russian military-linked cargo ship off Benghazi while helicopters of Haftar's Libyan National Army fired at them; Al Jazeera and Anadolu, citing Libyan media, report an attack on a Maltese-flagged commercial vessel (not independently confirmed). A Russian Emergencies Ministry Il-76 flew from Moscow to Benghazi after the blast (Defence Blog).

**Confirmed, claimed and unknown.** Kyiv has made no official claim; Axios's Barak Ravid, citing a source, attributes the attack to Ukraine's SBU. No Russian defence ministry statement had been found by 19:00 Madrid. If confirmed, it would be the first attack on a Russian Navy ship in the Mediterranean (ItaMilRadar).

**Context:** the *Merkury* had escorted a convoy of Russian government-linked cargo ships; Haftar's Libya is Russia's logistics hub towards the Sahel. The attack comes a day after the drone strike on the *Sparta II* in the Gulf of Finland and the drone alert in Kaliningrad (14:30 edition).

**What to watch:** a Russian MoD statement and the Libyan–Russian inquiry; any Ukrainian claim; confirmation and flag of the second vessel; reactions from Malta, Italy, Greece and the EU.

**Sources:** [AP](https://apnews.com/article/libya-russia-vessel-drone-benghazi-59f6f304f3053c69c8cc890138a94d1b), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/22/blast-russian-ship-suspected-drone-attack-benghazi-libya), [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2124512007227367890), [Naval News (H I Sutton)](https://x.com/i/status/2124528157332041792), [Militarnyi](https://militarnyi.com/en/news/satellite-images-confirm-destruction-of-corvette-mercury/), [Defence Blog](https://defence-blog.com/libya-says-russian-corvette-in-benghazi-hit-by-drones/), [OSINTtechnical](https://x.com/i/status/2124540778655461704), [Barak Ravid (Axios)](https://x.com/i/status/2124518612366950610), [ItaMilRadar](https://x.com/i/status/2124510436011720967), [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124564349796901372), [Anadolu](https://x.com/i/status/2124563168861041011), [sentdefender](https://x.com/i/status/2124551025415815402)
articles.why: CEAFE's assessment is that the war now has a maritime front in the central Mediterranean, a few hundred kilometres from Malta, Sicily and Crete, coasts of EU member states. A Maltese-flagged ship being targeted would put an EU member state's flag directly in the line of fire. No EU statement had been found by Sunday evening, although the EU naval operation IRINI patrols these waters.

articles.headline: Update: Iran war: Trump "inclined" to resume strikes after the new year as attacks on Hormuz shipping hit a record
articles.summary:
**President Trump told Fox News on Sunday that he is "inclined" to resume strikes on Iran after the new year if there is no deal, called the Iranian negotiators "professional tap dancers", and said of Iranian tankers testing the US blockade: "I hope they do, they'll all be at the bottom of the sea like the rest of the navy."**

At sea, Iran's navy said two supertankers struck naval mines after entering a "restricted area" east of the Strait of Hormuz (IRNA, Iranian state media; not independently confirmed). The Joint Maritime Information Centre (JMIC), in an advisory distributed by UKMTO, says seven tankers have been hit in the strait since 16 November and that no cargo vessel above 1,000 dwt transited between 19 and 21 November. UKMTO also reported an incident involving a tanker and "military forces" in the Gulf of Oman, near the US blockade line. A CNN analysis of UKMTO data finds that reported attacks on shipping exceeded 30 in October and at least 22 so far in November, against an average of about 10 a month earlier in the war.

**Context:** the US Embassy in Bahrain urged Americans to "heightened vigilance". War-risk insurance is quoted at 3.5–7.5% of hull value, against 0.10–0.25% before the war (Al Jazeera). The 14:30 edition covered Iran's strikes on Bahrain and the "line-breaker" tanker spoof.

**What to watch:** any deadline for talks; Iranian attempts to run the blockade; new JMIC/UKMTO advisories; Monday's oil-price reaction.

**Sources:** [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-warns-new-strikes-against-iran-after-new-year-calls-negotiators-professional-tap-dancers), [Clash Report clip](https://x.com/i/status/2124561307290796485), [Acyn clip](https://x.com/i/status/2124557520090063283), [Iran International (JMIC)](https://www.iranintl.com/en/202611223290), [IRNA](https://x.com/i/status/2124538349364908499), [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124534407134355579), [UKMTO via sentdefender](https://x.com/i/status/2124541498305720691), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/11/22/middleeast/hormuz-attacks-highest-levels-iran-war-intl), [Al Jazeera explainer](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/22/whats-behind-irans-escalation-of-attacks-in-the-gulf)
articles.why: the timetable for a new US campaign is being set in a television interview in Washington, while Europe, which depends on Gulf oil and LNG and pays the insurance and price premium, has no seat in the indirect talks.

articles.headline: Yemen–Saudi war: the Houthis say they struck the Rabigh refinery on the Red Sea
articles.summary:
**Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed "two precision military operations" against Saudi Arabia's Rabigh oil refinery on the Red Sea coast and a radar at Wadi al-Dawasir.**

The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted Houthi drones aimed at southern Saudi Arabia and the Riyadh region. Saudi-backed government forces claim to have killed or wounded at least 86 Houthi commanders and fighters, while the Houthis published footage of weapons depots they say they seized at Mokha. The internationally recognised government called the Houthi threat "a direct threat to international peace and security". All figures are claims by the parties.

**What to watch:** damage assessments at Rabigh; the front near Aden; any Red Sea shipping advisories.

**Sources:** [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124553704573689934), [Saudi-led coalition](https://x.com/i/status/2124551152025186604), [Anadolu](https://x.com/i/status/2124563577134551393), [Yemeni government](https://x.com/i/status/2124526444466647519), [MenchOsint](https://x.com/i/status/2124490578872127809)
articles.why: Saudi Red Sea energy infrastructure and the Bab el-Mandeb route, vital for Suez traffic to European ports, are again under attack.

articles.headline: Nuclear deterrence: French Rafale land on a Finnish highway; IISS says Sarmat may be entering service
articles.summary:
**French Rafale fighters of the 30th wing carried out their first touch-and-go on a Finnish highway during the exercise *Protective Fence 26*, alongside Finnish F/A-18s and Dutch F-35As, days after dual-capable Rafale B trained in the High North with Sweden (*Excalibur*).**

Finland and the Netherlands have agreed to contribute to French forward deterrence, although the Finnish exercise had no nuclear dimension (Etienne Marcuz). Separately, the International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS) says satellite imagery suggests Russia's RS-28 Sarmat intercontinental ballistic missile may have begun to enter service with the Strategic Rocket Forces.

**What to watch:** further French deployments in the Nordics; confirmation of Sarmat's operational status.

**Sources:** [Etienne Marcuz](https://x.com/i/status/2124560329937932312), [IISS](https://x.com/i/status/2124488323129282801)
articles.why: French extended deterrence for the Nordic EU member states is a European option alongside the US umbrella; Sarmat's entry into service would add to the Russian arsenal that many European leaders treat as unusable, while Moscow has warned that a war with Europe would be quick.

articles.headline: Update: Gulf of Finland and Kaliningrad: the drone strike on the *Sparta II* and the alert in the exclave bring the war to the doorstep of EU member states
articles.summary:
**Two separate episodes on Saturday 21 November have brought the Ukraine war to the waters and borders of EU member states.**

In the morning, between 07:40 and 07:50 Madrid time, at least two drones hit the Russian cargo ship *Sparta II* in international waters of the eastern Gulf of Finland, about 50 km west of the Russian island of Gogland (Suursaari), according to the Finnish Defence Forces. The 121-metre ship had left St Petersburg on Friday evening bound for Baltiysk, in Kaliningrad. It belongs to Oboronlogistika, a logistics company set up within Russia's defence ministry and under US sanctions since 2022; its cargo on this voyage is unknown. Estonia's Police and Border Guard Board says the explosions began while the ship was in an international lane inside Estonia's exclusive economic zone, outside its territorial sea. Burning and without steering, the ship drifted into the territorial waters of Finland, an EU member state and NATO member, and anchored south of Loviisa. Its 16 crew were evacuated to a Russian ship; no injuries or pollution have been reported. On Sunday the Finnish Border Guard, which leads the rescue with Estonian and Russian vessels, said there were no more visible flames but the cargo was still hot, the ship had a slight list and sinking could not be ruled out; the plan is for the Russian rescue ships *Spasatel Karev* and *Murman* to tow it into Russian waters (Finnish Border Guard, STT). In the evening, Kaliningrad Oblast went on drone alert: sirens sounded and Khrabrovo airport was briefly restricted. Governor Alexei Besprozvannykh said a "suspicious object" had been detected in the Neman district "from the direction of Lithuania" and, after checks, that there was "no threat" (Kommersant).

**Confirmed, claimed and unknown.** Finland's Defence Forces say Ukraine is "likely" behind the ship strike, without conclusive evidence; a Border Guard officer told AFP a Ukrainian drone hit the ship; Kyiv has not claimed it. Ukrainian monitoring channels reported explosions near the Baltic Fleet base at Baltiysk, but no official source confirms a strike, damage or casualties in Kaliningrad, and a widely shared "explosion" photo was in fact a fire on Iran's Qeshm Island. Lithuania's Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys said his country "categorically rejects" claims of involvement and "has never authorized the use of its airspace for attacks against targets in the Russian Federation, including in the present case"; Lithuania's crisis centre said the air force detected no drones. No Finnish, Estonian, Lithuanian, Latvian, Polish or NATO source confirms that any drone overflew an EU member state; the route of the drones is unknown. No statement from the Russian defence ministry or the Kremlin had been found by Sunday midday.

**Context:** Prime Minister Petteri Orpo wrote that "war is spilling over into our immediate vicinity" and that "Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor". Defence Minister Antti Häkkänen told Yle the Gulf strikes are "a step in a more serious direction", that Finland had no prior warning and that Helsinki contacted Kyiv to stress the risks of the area. Finland is also investigating a suspected incursion of up to 4.1 km into its airspace by a Russian helicopter off Loviisa, and Swedish fighters were scrambled in support of Finland. Estonia's navy commander, Commodore Ivo Värk, said further attacks "cannot be ruled out" and that everything outside coastal states' territorial waters is "an entirely legitimate place for both warring parties to conduct their military operations". On 11 November a Ukrainian-claimed strike had already hit the Russian corvette *Naro-Fominsk* near Gogland, then inside Russian territorial waters. Russia has repeatedly linked Kaliningrad to its nuclear arsenal: in late September 2026 its embassies warned that any attempt to isolate the exclave could bring the use of its full arsenal, including nuclear weapons, and on 2 October President Putin said a direct attack on the Russian Federation, "in this case, we are referring to Kaliningrad", would put the deployment of "all the weapons at our country's disposal" on the agenda.

**What to watch:** whether the ship is towed out of Finnish waters or sinks; any Ukrainian claim or Russian defence ministry statement; the outcome of Finland's helicopter investigation; Monday's North Atlantic Council meeting on the Russian objects in Polish airspace.

**Sources:** [Finnish Border Guard, 21 Nov](https://www.epressi.com/tiedotteet/turvallisuus/rajavartiolaitos-jatkaa-pelastustoiminnan-johtamista-suomenlahdella..html), [Finnish Border Guard, 22 Nov](https://www.epressi.com/tiedotteet/turvallisuus/pelastustoimet-suomenlahdella-jatkuvat-rajavartiolaitoksen-johtovastuulla.html), [STT via SSS](https://www.sss.fi/2026/11/sparta-ii-rahtilaiva-on-vahan-kallellaan-mutta-ei-uhkaa-kaatua-rajavartiolaitos-arvioi-pelastustoimien-paattyvan-taman-paivan-aikana/), [Yle, Häkkänen](https://yle.fi/a/74-20258297), [AFP](https://www.afp.com/en/russian-cargo-ship-catches-fire-after-ukrainian-strike-baltic), [ERR, Estonian Navy](https://news.err.ee/1610202953/estonian-navy-more-attacks-in-the-gulf-of-finland-cannot-be-ruled-out), [ERR](https://news.err.ee/1610202715/russian-cargo-ship-catches-fire-in-gulf-of-finland-moscow-claims-drone-hit), [Helsinki Times](https://www.helsinkitimes.com/finland/finland-news/domestic/29522-firefighting-efforts-continue-on-russian-cargo-ship-in-finnish-waters-amid-sinking-risk.html), [Kommersant](https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/9127202), [LRT/BNS, Budrys](https://www.lrt.lt/naujienos/pasaulyje/6/3122038/kestutis-budrys-atmete-teiginius-kad-lietuva-dalyvavo-atakose-pries-kaliningrado-sriti), [Kyiv Independent](https://kyivindependent.com/explosions-reported-near-russian-baltic-fleet-base-in-kaliningrad-oblast-amid-drone-alerts/), [ISW](https://understandingwar.org/research/russia-ukraine/russian-offensive-campaign-assessment-november-21-2026/), [Swedish Armed Forces](https://x.com/i/status/2124196659173150901), [Yle, Naro-Fominsk](https://yle.fi/a/74-20256496), [Arms Control Association](https://www.armscontrol.org/act/2026-11/news/russia-issues-nuclear-threats-over-kaliningrad), [ABC/Reuters, Putin](https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-10-02/putin-kaliningrad-threat-nuclear-weapons/107219366), [Russian Embassy UK, 29 Sep](https://x.com/i/status/2104885755076296894)
articles.why: CEAFE's assessment is that these incidents differ from strikes between Russia and Ukraine on the front or in the Black Sea: they immediately involve the waters, airspace, rescue services and political responsibility of EU member states and NATO members such as Finland, Estonia and Lithuania. Opening another front around Kaliningrad, an exclave bordered by Lithuania and Poland, is very negative and dangerous for the EU. So far the response has come capital by capital — Helsinki, Tallinn, Vilnius and Stockholm — rather than as a common European position, although the risk is shared.

articles.headline: Iran strikes Bahrain: the IRGC claims hits on US Patriot radars, Manama says a civilian site was hit
articles.summary:
**Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Saturday evening that it fired missiles and drones at US Patriot radars at two bases used by US forces in Bahrain, Sheikh Isa and Juffair, in response to US drone "violations" of Iranian airspace.**

Bahrain's Interior Ministry said a fire broke out at a civilian industrial facility near Manama after what it called "Iranian aggression"; Bahraini and Pakistani citizens were injured, one of them critically (Anadolu, Al Jazeera). Bahrain condemned the "unlawful" attacks and urged the UN Security Council to take "firm measures to compel Iran" to implement Resolution 2817. Saudi Arabia condemned the "heinous Iranian attacks" "in the strongest terms", the UAE spoke of a "flagrant violation" of sovereignty and Jordan of a "dangerous escalation".

**Context:** on Sunday the IRGC claimed it had shot down a 20th US MQ-1 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz (IRGC statement via IRNA, Iranian state media; no US confirmation). CENTCOM again denied Iran's earlier F-16 claim. The US naval blockade of Iran reached 130 consecutive days on Saturday (Euronews). Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said the US–Israeli war on Iran has created an "economic burden" and that a ceasefire is needed.

**What to watch:** a US response; a Security Council meeting; a joint Gulf Cooperation Council statement.

**Sources:** [Al Jazeera](https://x.com/i/status/2124257796854366554), [Al Jazeera, Bahrain at the UN](https://x.com/i/status/2124280883360436272), [Bahrain Interior Ministry via Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2124255325272285592), [Anadolu](https://v.aa.com.tr/4133397), [Saudi Foreign Ministry](https://x.com/i/status/2124458314197000450), [UAE](https://x.com/i/status/2124473069922381829), [Jordan](https://x.com/i/status/2124441203450188273), [IRNA, IRGC claim](https://x.com/i/status/2124425078205010012), [CENTCOM](https://x.com/i/status/2124341434287353860), [Al Jazeera, Fidan](https://x.com/i/status/2124355960420663559)
articles.why: Bahrain hosts the US Fifth Fleet and is a naval hub for European navies in the Gulf. Each strike on a Gulf state raises the risk for European personnel and shipping and feeds the energy prices Europe pays, while the responses come from Riyadh, Abu Dhabi, Amman and the UN Security Council, where the EU as such has no seat.

articles.headline: Ukraine war: Russian drones destroy a building in the Kyiv region; a Ukrainian drone hits a fuel truck on Crimea's only land route
articles.summary:
**A Russian drone strike brought down part of a five-storey apartment building in Dymer, in the Kyiv region, overnight; up to 14 people were feared trapped, and by Sunday morning one body had been recovered and three people were injured, according to President Zelensky.**

Ukraine's Air Force says Russia launched 186 attack drones overnight and that 161 were shot down; 30 people were injured over the day (Kyiv Independent, Ukrainian Air Force). Zelensky called US delays in delivering Patriot missiles already paid for by allies "difficult to understand", after Russia fired 165 missiles in a week.

**Context:** on the Ukrainian side, a mid-range strike drone hit a Russian fuel tanker truck on the R-280 highway, the only overland route to Crimea since the road span of the Kerch (Crimean) Bridge was destroyed in mid-November (@OSINTtechnical). Ukrainian drones reportedly hit a Rosgvardia facility in Krasnodar (unverified). The UK will produce long-range "middle strike" drones for Ukraine in Britain.

**What to watch:** the final toll in Dymer; any US decision on Patriot deliveries; strikes on the R-280 corridor.

**Sources:** [Zelensky](https://x.com/i/status/2124419869584113946), [Kyiv Independent](https://x.com/i/status/2124366937333399858), [Kyiv Independent](https://x.com/i/status/2124425153278812609), [Ukrainian Air Force](https://x.com/i/status/2124453518199390325), [Zelensky on Patriot](https://x.com/i/status/2124457238781653317), [@OSINTtechnical](https://x.com/i/status/2124453862476325287), [Krasnodar](https://x.com/i/status/2124348956838683100), [UK drones](https://x.com/i/status/2124319137082306789)
articles.why: the air war is being fought with weapons whose supply depends on decisions in Washington (Patriot) and in European capitals, while each strike on Crimea's supply routes widens the war's reach.

articles.headline: Yemen–Saudi war: Houthi forces within 80 km of Aden
articles.summary:
**Houthi forces have advanced to within 80 km north and 110 km west of Aden, the seat of Yemen's Saudi-backed government, Reuters reports.**

Government forces are reinforcing checkpoints, but rifts between Saudi-backed and southern separatist factions hamper a coordinated defence. The Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed a Houthi drone heading for Riyadh. Taiz remains under siege, and the UN says food and medicine supplies there have fallen by 90%.

**Context:** the US Senate could vote as early as the week of 30 November on blocking the US–Saudi nuclear cooperation pact; Houthi attacks have raised concerns over reactor security.

**What to watch:** the fighting on Aden's approaches; further Houthi strikes on Saudi energy sites.

**Sources:** [Reuters via Faytuks](https://x.com/i/status/2124309151912222803), [Saudi-led coalition](https://x.com/i/status/2124446805203054781), [UN on Taiz](https://x.com/i/status/2124317866165997910), [US Senate and Saudi nuclear pact](https://x.com/i/status/2124311116746567751)
articles.why: the fall of Aden would give the Houthis control of both sides of the southern approach to the Red Sea, where the EU's naval operations Aspides and Atalanta protect shipping to and from Europe.

articles.headline: Actualización: Bloqueo de EE. UU. a Irán: minas, un ataque discutido y los plazos de Trump
articles.summary:
- **Hechos:** el CENTCOM afirma que inutilizó el *Pacific Archer* con un ataque de precisión contra su popa el 26 de noviembre (@sentdefender https://x.com/i/status/2126514662971724034). La IRGC asegura que dos petroleros chocaron con minas cerca de Jasab y en el este del estrecho (Al Jazeera https://x.com/i/status/2126442190276591784). El comandante de la Armada iraní afirma que el CENTCOM cobra 2,5 millones de dólares por cada buque escoltado por el corredor sur, sin reembolso si es atacado (@MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2126420765377482900); es una afirmación iraní. El secretario general de la OMI, Arsenio Domínguez, dijo a Al Jazeera que la organización no tiene constancia de ningún acuerdo entre Irán y Omán para regular el tráfico en el estrecho (https://x.com/i/status/2126567092963209320). Trump dice que la victoria sobre Irán llegará «cuando yo quiera», pero que da al régimen «una oportunidad de ser listo» (@FaytuksNetwork https://x.com/i/status/2126378283633684836; vídeo original no comprobado).

- **Europa:** el ministro italiano de Exteriores, Antonio Tajani, afirma, citando a los investigadores kuwaitíes, que un dron de fabricación iraní mató a dos italianos en Kuwait; Teherán niega haberlo lanzado desde su territorio y ofrece una investigación conjunta (Al Jazeera https://x.com/i/status/2126472453232717999).

- **Por qué importa:** ciudadanos y navieras europeos ya están pagando el coste de la guerra del bloqueo.

articles.headline: Actualización: Se intensifica la guerra entre Arabia Saudí y Yemen
articles.summary:
- **Hechos:** el portavoz de la coalición liderada por Arabia Saudí, el general de división Turki al Maliki, anuncia la interceptación de un misil de crucero hutí dirigido contra Riad (Al Jazeera https://x.com/i/status/2126523001458078176). Se lanzaron misiles balísticos contra Jizán y Jamis Mushait; el portavoz saudí afirma haber interceptado uno (@MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2126610162332872753). Las fuerzas del Gobierno yemení reconocido internacionalmente lanzaron ataques aéreos en territorio hutí, con al menos 121 hutíes muertos o heridos en un día (Al Jazeera https://x.com/i/status/2126629825943310408). Al Masirah, afín a los hutíes, afirma que ataques saudíes alcanzaron redes de telecomunicaciones en Al Baida (Al Jazeera https://x.com/i/status/2126525237491593607). Restos hallados en Al Yauf serían de un misil chino DF-15A, el segundo lanzamiento saudí conocido; Riad nunca ha reconocido poseerlo (@ClashReport https://x.com/i/status/2126609543555961147; @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2126434287780044823).

- **Afirmaciones:** cuentas afines a los hutíes aseguran que un ataque aéreo saudí mató a 11 civiles, la mayoría niños, en Al Turba (Taiz) (vía @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2126402116076114361); sin verificación independiente.

articles.headline: Guerra de Ucrania: el puente de Kerch y los ataques en profundidad
articles.summary:
- **Hechos:** The Telegraph informa de que Zelenski quiere destruir por completo el puente de Crimea (Kerch) y de que Ucrania prepara más ataques, tras el del 18 de noviembre, que destruyó parte del tramo de carretera (@ClashReport https://x.com/i/status/2126605412124496164, https://x.com/i/status/2126604385593577489). El Ministerio de Defensa británico publicó imágenes de satélite del puente y de sus defensas antiaéreas (vía @MilitarySummary https://x.com/i/status/2126377715301548098; original no comprobado). Una cuenta prorrusa atribuye al Wall Street Journal que Ucrania usó en el ataque las comunicaciones por satélite israelíes HiSKY (https://x.com/i/status/2126640229201367310); original del WSJ no comprobado.

- **Ataques en profundidad (afirmaciones):** el grupo Black Spark reivindica, junto a las Fuerzas de Operaciones Especiales ucranianas, un ataque contra la planta de caucho sintético de Yefrémov (región de Tula) la noche del 27 de noviembre, que describe como importante para el programa de misiles (vía @Schizointel https://x.com/i/status/2126610107806953818). El Ministerio de Defensa ruso afirma haber interceptado 1.601 drones en 24 horas (https://x.com/i/status/2126610121014853657).

- **Mar Negro:** drones rusos alcanzaron dos graneleros cerca de Odesa, el *Virtuous Striker* y el *Gladiator*, gestionados por empresas griegas y con destino a Egipto y Turquía; sin heridos (vía @Schizointel https://x.com/i/status/2126377868729147876).

- **Líderes:** Zelenski dice que EE. UU. «no puede ser un simple mediador neutral» y cuestiona sus reticencias sobre bases en Ucrania (@ClashReport https://x.com/i/status/2126585059201188033, https://x.com/i/status/2126588219567272326). El ministro polaco de Exteriores, Sikorski, compara los ataques rusos contra Ucrania con los V-2 nazis sobre Londres (https://x.com/i/status/2126413340180365735).

articles.headline: Fuerzas estratégicas y control de armamentos
