articles.headline: Update: Italians killed in Kuwait — Iran denies, Riyadh condemns "Iranian aggression", Araghchi calls Rome
articles.summary:
Iran officially denied involvement in the drone strike in Kuwait that killed two Italian technicians. An Iranian military official called it a “false flag” (@IranObserver0 https://x.com/i/status/2126018640231215321). Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said he gave his condolences in calls with his Italian (Antonio Tajani) and Kuwaiti counterparts (@araghchi via @GeromanAT https://x.com/i/status/2126044199967670486). Pro-Iranian accounts call the incident a psyop to pull Europe into the war (https://x.com/i/status/2126089288437624937). Donald Trump: “Victory [in Iran] will happen whenever I want it to happen” (clip via @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2126093293884707104, not checked against the original).

**What to watch:** Kuwaiti and Italian findings on the drone's origin, and the security of European contractors at Gulf bases.
articles.why: these are the first European deaths in the Gulf war, and Rome and Tehran are now talking directly. Responsibility is still disputed, and that will shape any Italian or EU response.

articles.headline: Update: Saudi–Yemen war — new launches, Houthi pressure on Aden
articles.summary:
After the hit on the Jizan refinery, more launches from Yemen disrupted Riyadh airspace in the evening, and alerts sounded in Abha and Khamis Mushait (see Early warning). @MenchOsint notes that the Saudi spokesperson reported a drone intercepted about 30 minutes before the alerts were issued (https://x.com/i/status/2126079116634132728). Russian milblog Rybar and @war_cube report Ansar Allah (Houthi) forces advancing towards Aden and building defences near Aryab on the Abyan border (via @GeromanAT https://x.com/i/status/2126048132773339148, https://x.com/i/status/2126044156518715395; unverified). A Sana'a-based journalist says Ansar Allah sees Saudi Arabia as “the head of the snake” (@DropSiteNews via @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2126149359368601947).

**What to watch:** confirmed damage at Ras Tanura, Saudi strikes in response, and the front in Abyan.
articles.why: Saudi energy infrastructure (Ras Tanura, Jizan) is directly at stake for oil prices and the Red Sea route. A Houthi push on Aden would widen the war on land.

articles.headline: Ukraine war: night strikes; Berlin and Rome urge Kyiv not to widen the war
articles.summary:
Footage on Russian channels shows a jet-powered Geran-5 drone over Kharkiv, where an aviation institute was hit, and a drone strike in Odesa. Both cities report deaths and damage over two days (@Zlatti_71 https://x.com/i/status/2126131729714852176). Kryvyi Rih has been under waves of drone strikes since 25 November, with power cuts (https://x.com/i/status/2126124406015476017). A Russian strike on the evening of 26 November set an unnamed enterprise in Khmelnytskyi district on fire; there were no casualties (https://x.com/i/status/2126127873152975235). Germany and Italy both cautioned Kyiv against carrying the war into new regions after Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian vessels in the Baltic and off Libya (https://x.com/i/status/2126125122645831813). Libya's LNA reportedly threatened Ukraine with retaliation over the drone attack in Benghazi port (repost via @GeromanAT https://x.com/i/status/2126050847045955924; unverified).

**What to watch:** Russian naval escort patterns in the Mediterranean, and Kyiv's reply to its European partners.
articles.why: Ukraine's maritime strikes in the Baltic and the Mediterranean bring the war onto Europe's doorstep. Berlin and Rome now publicly want to contain it.

articles.headline: Washington's Ukraine line: Trump says Putin wants a settlement; Kushner speaks of a "European proxy war"
articles.summary:
Trump said Vladimir Putin wants the conflict settled and that all sides must want it. The remarks follow a joint statement with NATO's Secretary General and a Kremlin reply (@Zlatti_71 https://x.com/i/status/2126133080775708914). Trump also said he told Putin, during their talks in China, that he wants him to “pull back all military aggression” (@FaytuksNetwork https://x.com/i/status/2126049981530313094). Jared Kushner called the war a “European proxy war”: “Europe is funding and arming Ukraine against Russia” (clip via @MichaKobs https://x.com/i/status/2126130131525661051). He also said no pressure has been put on Ukraine and that Washington wants to give it formal security guarantees (@mtracey https://x.com/i/status/2126182371506401282). The quotes come from clips and were not checked against full originals.

**What to watch:** what the security guarantees contain, and whether Europeans get a seat at the next round.
articles.why: the US negotiators describe Europe as a party to the war, not as a party at the table. No single EU state can change that alone; only a common European position can.

articles.headline: Space and strategic forces: nuclear-satellite denial, "Starmind" and China–Russia talks
articles.summary:
Moscow denies any plan for a nuclear-armed spacecraft (see Early warning). Chinese state broadcaster CGTN reports that the US government approved a SpaceX constellation of up to one million satellites (“Starmind”) for AI data centres in orbit (https://x.com/i/status/2126154042288087362). CGTN also reports the Chinese and Russian militaries held a strategic consultation by video conference on 26 November (https://x.com/i/status/2126143975384113271) and promotes China–Pakistan cooperation in orbit (https://x.com/i/status/2126121326075072856). These are state-media claims. In the United States, the Army's first Dark Eagle (LRHW) hypersonic battery is fully fielded and operational, nearly three years late, according to Lt. Gen. Lozano (@FaytuksNetwork https://x.com/i/status/2126067091086413966; image: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HYFOwGWW4AA8NYb.jpg).

**What to watch:** any Russian launch matching the reported profile, and EU and ESA responses on sovereign constellations.
articles.why: the denial follows a German report on a nuclear-armed Russian satellite (covered on 24 November). Mega-constellations under US licence deepen Europe's dependence in orbit.

articles.headline: Northern Europe: Sweden's NATO contribution bill; seizures in the Baltic
articles.summary:
A government bill now before the Swedish Riksdag (2026/27:6, Sweden's contribution to NATO deterrence and defence in 2027) would let the government deploy up to 3,900 ground troops and 850 naval personnel, among other forces, without a new vote in parliament. This is the reading of a critical commentator, @mazzenilsson (https://x.com/i/status/2126085054224892270); the bill text was not checked. A video commentary relayed by @GeromanAT says the Wall Street Journal reported Nordic alarm after Russia's Baltic Fleet ended two years of NATO-member ship seizures (https://x.com/i/status/2126043386419269963; WSJ original not checked). Nordic Monitor reports calls to remove Türkiye's ambassador to Finland over a fund scandal (https://x.com/i/status/2126148927766364573).

**What to watch:** the Riksdag debate and Russian naval escorts in the Baltic.
articles.why: standing Nordic contributions to NATO's forward posture are the backbone of Baltic deterrence.

articles.headline: Two Italian air-defence technicians killed in drone strike in Kuwait; Iran denies
articles.summary:
Two Italian technicians were killed and two other people injured when drones hit an air-defence detection station at a Kuwaiti military base, a source told Reuters. ANSA reports the two worked for Rheinmetall Italia; Italy's Defence Ministry confirmed they were on the base. Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, in a call with his Kuwaiti counterpart, “categorically denied” that an Iranian drone was involved; Iranian military officials called it a possible “false flag”. Italian PM Giorgia Meloni commented on the deaths.

**Context:** Italy has air-refuelling aircraft in Egypt (Luxor, Hurghada) and Saudi Arabia (Taif), according to @MenchOsint (unverified). OSINT accounts suggest a Rheinmetall Skynex battery deployed in Kuwait may have been hit (unverified); another hypothesis circulating is that the deaths date from the 18 November IRGC strikes on Ali Al Salem Air Base (speculation, unverified).

**Background (CEAFE archive):** It is not the first Iranian strike on Italian forces in Kuwait: in March 2026 @F_CEAFE reposted ItaMilRadar's satellite analysis of the aftermath of the Iranian attack on the Italian Predator base in Kuwait (https://x.com/i/status/2036886151416398301).

**What to watch:** an official attribution by Kuwait or the US; Italy's response (Parliament, posture of Italian assets in the Gulf); further Iranian statements.

**Sources:** Reuters https://x.com/i/status/2126015681116123368; Al Jazeera English https://x.com/i/status/2126014235515687421; @FaytuksNetwork (ANSA) https://x.com/i/status/2125950566555951156; @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2125983457067040922, https://x.com/i/status/2126009957204025390, https://x.com/i/status/2125953050443382915, https://x.com/i/status/2125989586753003905, https://x.com/i/status/2125979886162514055
articles.why: European personnel and European-built air defences are now direct casualties of the Gulf war. That raises political pressure in Rome and on EU partners and tests how Europe protects contractors deployed with partner forces.

articles.headline: Update: Hormuz — another tanker on fire, seven attacks in four days
articles.summary:
Video posted on the evening of 26 November appears to show a tanker burning near Khasab, at the mouth of the Strait (unverified). Earlier footage released by the IRGC Navy shows two tankers exploding after what it says were naval mines north of Khasab (relayed by @MilitarySummary). A UKMTO advisory issued for the Joint Maritime Information Center lists seven attacks on vessels between 22 and 25 November. The IISS notes that war-risk premiums for Gulf voyages rose from 0.10–0.25% before the war to 2.5–7%: up to US$17.5m for a tanker carrying a US$250m cargo.

**What to watch:** the UKMTO original advisory and ship names; any naval mine-countermeasures deployment, including European ships.

**Sources:** @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2126008159525282044, https://x.com/i/status/2126007905367544292; @GeromanAT repost of @MilitarySummary https://x.com/i/status/2125948005811720227; @sentdefender https://x.com/i/status/2125986712203432276; @IISS_org https://x.com/i/status/2125999558773604751
articles.why: Higher insurance and freight costs feed straight into European energy prices. Mines widen the threat from single attacks to the whole area.

articles.headline: Update: Saudi–Yemen — Jizan refinery hit, casualties confirmed
articles.summary:
The Saudi military spokesperson said the Jizan refinery was struck by a projectile fired from Yemen. @MenchOsint notes this is the third time in a week Riyadh has acknowledged an interception failure. The Saudi Ministry of Energy reported at least one dead and several workers injured. Satellite images shared by @tom_bike show two damaged storage tanks at the Ras Tanura terminal, not the crude export facilities (unverified). Long fuel queues were reported in Jizan (unverified).

**What to watch:** Saudi retaliation in Yemen; the status of Ras Tanura exports.

**Sources:** @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2125966901142536613, https://x.com/i/status/2126015013907280328; @tom_bike via @MenchOsint https://x.com/i/status/2125985070284484797
articles.why: Strikes on Saudi refining and export sites add to the Hormuz disruption and threaten supply to European markets.

articles.headline: Ukraine war: strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure, warning of a new massive attack; Rome and Berlin warn on Mediterranean strikes
articles.summary:
Russian drones reportedly hit the National Bank of Ukraine's banknote-paper factory in Zhytomyr region (@DD_Geopolitics, unverified). Russia's Defence Ministry announced new strikes, including in Kharkiv. A Ukrainian statement relayed by @MilitarySummary says that, according to intelligence, Russia is completing preparations for another massive attack (original not checked). Donetsk regional police say only about 10,000 civilians remain in Kramatorsk. Italy's Meloni and Germany's Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul cautioned against the “geographical expansion” of the war while reaffirming support for Ukraine (Kyiv Independent). Reuters reports that Meloni warned Ukraine over its strike in the Mediterranean, after Italy said Ukrainian attacks on Russian vessels in Libyan waters violated Libya's sovereignty (Al Jazeera). Polish Foreign Minister Radosław Sikorski said Russia is not winning on the battlefield and that Ukraine strikes military targets while Russia strikes civilian ones (clips via @clashreport).

**What to watch:** a large Russian missile and drone strike in the coming nights; Kyiv's response to the Italian and German warnings.

**Sources:** @DD_Geopolitics via @GeromanAT https://x.com/i/status/2126016421994090745; @MilitarySummary via @GeromanAT https://x.com/i/status/2125992768577192191, https://x.com/i/status/2125986095691178299, https://x.com/i/status/2125986487942652038; Kyiv Independent https://x.com/i/status/2125999006098624612; Reuters https://x.com/i/status/2125988005047357615; Al Jazeera https://x.com/i/status/2126005565407293824; @clashreport https://x.com/i/status/2126003283600826760, https://x.com/i/status/2126003538103062772
articles.why: Ukraine's maritime campaign has reached the central Mediterranean, and Rome objects. This splits Europe over how far Ukraine may take the war at sea.

articles.headline: Hybrid threats in Europe: Russian sabotage up 16%, Iranian operations under scrutiny
articles.summary:
The IISS reports that recorded Russian-linked sabotage in Europe rose 16% in the 12 months to September 2026, even as overall recorded Russian activity fell, with surges concentrated on Poland, Germany and the Baltic states. A second IISS paper examines about 80 Iranian external operations in Europe and says less-protected targets were pinpointed after the Gulf war began. British security experts warn that Tehran and Moscow could cooperate on covert operations in Europe (report via @clashreport).

**What to watch:** joint attribution by EU or NATO; protection of critical infrastructure.

**Sources:** @IISS_org https://x.com/i/status/2125957777147277740, https://x.com/i/status/2125983079856570608; @clashreport https://x.com/i/status/2125981453276110967
articles.why: The Gulf war and the Ukraine war meet on European soil through sabotage. Frontline states carry most of the exposure.

articles.headline: Strategic and space competition
articles.summary:
A report widely shared on the list says the US has entered an “unprecedented three-way nuclear rivalry” with China and Russia (@KingstonAReif https://x.com/i/status/2125989101656535218). CSIS warns that China, which has landed a reusable rocket and plans massive LEO constellations, challenges US satellite leadership ahead of the 2027 World Radiocommunication Conference in Shanghai (https://x.com/i/status/2125983046553714724). Chinese state broadcaster CGTN says several major types of military equipment will make their public debut at Airshow China (https://x.com/i/status/2125962294316470351; state media). No new counter-space (RPO or shadowing) incident was found in this window.

**What to watch:** new types shown at Airshow China; European positions ahead of WRC-27.

**Sources:** as linked above.
articles.why: Europe has neither a nuclear deterrent nor a satellite constellation of matching scale. Spectrum and orbit decisions at WRC-27 will shape IRIS².

articles.headline: Update: Strait of Hormuz — tankers on fire, Iranian mine claims, Israeli threat
articles.summary:
Iran's IRGC Navy says two tankers, including a very large crude carrier, caught fire near Khasab early on 26 November, and UKMTO reports a separate projectile strike on an outbound tanker in the eastern Strait on 25 November. Reuters reports Iran claims mine strikes on ships; oil prices first rose on supply concerns, then fell back by midday. An Israeli military spokesperson told Al Jazeera that Israel is ready to attack Iran “with force at any given moment – even independently without the Americans”, while Iran's nuclear chief Mohammad Eslami called claims that Iran seeks a nuclear weapon fabricated. Al Jazeera, citing local media, says Iran-backed groups in Iraq are preparing to strike US military assets if Washington launches new attacks on Iran.

**Background (CEAFE archive):** CEAFE has logged Iran's mining of the Strait since 10 March 2026, when CNN reported the first mines being laid ([repost](https://x.com/i/status/2031469865165304041)); in April the Pentagon estimated six months to clear them, and on 19 November the IRGC Navy already claimed two supertankers had caught fire after hitting mines ([repost](https://x.com/i/status/2123404887622889883)).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Hormuz carries a large share of Europe's oil and LNG imports; every incident feeds energy prices and the EU's maritime security posture (Aspides).

- **Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125905301341601888, https://x.com/i/status/2125922999249371228, https://x.com/i/status/2125922614098956420 (https://reut.rs/4eYZTBe), https://x.com/i/status/2125897350463803498 (https://aje.news/8m8sci), https://x.com/i/status/2125887283916386678 (https://aje.news/wsbmy1), https://x.com/i/status/2125864634976538902 (https://aje.news/kp3vwo). An unverified OSINT post says Iran fired cruise missiles at vessels in the Strait in the early morning (@FotrosYadegaar via list repost, https://x.com/i/status/2125864018929746155).

- **Follow-up:** UKMTO advisories; ship identities; any US response.

articles.headline: Update: Saudi–Houthi war — Riyadh alerts and strikes on Sana'a
articles.summary:
After the overnight Houthi missile fire reported at 08:30, Riyadh's airspace was disrupted at 08:30 UTC by missile/drone threats and Saudi airstrikes were reported in Sana'a. New satellite imagery shared by @SoarAtlas shows a large plume of black smoke over the Ras Tanura oil facilities (https://x.com/i/status/2125863393001111789, image not verified). OSINT trackers list regional support flights (Egyptian, Kuwaiti, Turkish and US aircraft) around the Saudi operations.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Ras Tanura is one of the world's key oil terminals; a widening Saudi–Yemen war threatens Red Sea and Gulf shipping.

- **Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125873981085397162, https://x.com/i/status/2125915623012049388, https://x.com/i/status/2125863393001111789.

articles.headline: Ukraine: ballistic strikes on Kyiv, warning of a new energy offensive, Eurofighter request
articles.summary:
Russian attacks killed 10 people and injured 58 across Ukraine over the past day, with ballistic missiles striking Kyiv and 113 drones launched (Kyiv Independent). President Zelensky says Russia is preparing a new mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure. Ukraine has reportedly asked Italy for 10 to 20 first-generation (Tranche 1) Eurofighter Typhoons; Italy has 26 Tranche 1 jets in service (@clashreport). Italy has condemned Ukrainian attacks on Russian ships in Libyan waters, warning Kyiv against widening the war (@clashreport, repost). Finnish President Stubb said he does not expect the war to end by the end of the year and that Ukraine must prepare for a harsh winter.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a European fighter transfer would be a European-sourced air-defence contribution; strikes on energy raise Ukraine's winter needs ahead of EU financing decisions.

- **Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125915499284275402, https://x.com/i/status/2125920242475893147, https://x.com/i/status/2125894833617387688 (https://clashreport.com/defense/articles/ukraine-italy-eurofighter-tranche-1-sz83bkmbg8c), https://x.com/i/status/2125864671034921437, https://x.com/i/status/2125870827971264861. Also: reports of Russia deploying “Molnya-13” heavy drones with a 50 km range (via @MilitarySummary repost, https://x.com/i/status/2125872411232874638, unverified); a Western model puts worst-case exhaustion of Ukraine's combat-ready force at November 2028 and Russia's at December 2029 (@Zlatti_71, https://x.com/i/status/2125886288968421785).

articles.headline: Russia's strategic forces: Sarmat, a general's arrest, Sputnik-S
articles.summary:
IISS analysis of satellite imagery suggests the RS-28 Sarmat ICBM may have begun to enter service with the Strategic Rocket Forces, with further flight trials possible because of reliability concerns. A Moscow garrison military court placed Colonel General Yuri Grekhov, deputy commander of the Aerospace Forces for armaments, in custody on 25 November; charges are not public and reports point to corruption. French analyst Etienne Marcuz discusses the credibility of Russia's “Sputnik-S” programme, suspected of being an orbital nuclear weapon after a German intelligence warning (counter-space thread).

- **Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125925041468576229 (image: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HYDNjvxW4AAYI2A.jpg — satellite imagery graphic), https://x.com/i/status/2125885633721749964, https://x.com/i/status/2125888265316335896, https://x.com/i/status/2125881368135569760. Russian Security Council criticism of NATO's casualty comparison was relayed from @mfa_russia (Russian state source, https://x.com/i/status/2125895104665645554).

articles.headline: Indo-Pacific and elsewhere
articles.summary:
China's Defence Ministry criticised the US deployment of F-15EX fighters to an overseas base and Japan's defence policy changes (CGTN, Chinese state media). CCTV showed the PLA 83rd Group Army training on a “new generation” IFV (Janes). UAE cargo flights to Ethiopia (see Early warning) point to continued arms flows in the Horn of Africa.

- **Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125911918791761940, https://x.com/i/status/2125917362100564275, https://x.com/i/status/2125869057979060327.

articles.headline: Update: Yemen war — Houthis claim strikes on Ras Tanura, Jeddah, Jizan and Riyadh
articles.summary: Ansarallah (the Houthis) claimed attacks on four targets inside Saudi Arabia on 25 November, including the Ras Tanura refinery and export terminal in the Eastern Province (Drop Site News via @MenchOsint, https://x.com/i/status/2125677126405746923; Antiwar.com relaying spokesman Yahya Saree, https://x.com/i/status/2125742753904509431). The group says it also targeted the ports of Jeddah and Jizan. The Saudi spokesperson acknowledged a hit at Jizan and debris falling at Jeddah (@MenchOsint, https://x.com/i/status/2125663583174602826, https://x.com/i/status/2125678483967971398; image: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HX_tT-xXUAAkbqt.jpg). Overnight the coalition reported intercepting two ballistic missiles aimed at Riyadh and a cruise missile aimed at the west of the kingdom (Al Jazeera English, https://x.com/i/status/2125705039268221282, https://x.com/i/status/2125692731947094275). CGTN (Chinese state media) aired smoke over a Saudi refinery (https://x.com/i/status/2125816827850985478). The scale of damage at Ras Tanura is unconfirmed; one account on the list calls it a "major blow" to the world's largest offshore crude loading facility (https://x.com/i/status/2125687840059330723, commentary).
articles.why: Ras Tanura is a key node for Saudi exports. A sustained Houthi campaign against Saudi energy, on top of the Hormuz mining, threatens oil and fuel prices in Europe.

articles.headline: Update: Iran war — tanker hit off Dubai as Washington tightens "coordinated action" in Hormuz
articles.summary: After Iran said ships had hit mines in Hormuz and warned vessels to coordinate passage (Reuters, https://x.com/i/status/2125683477169201571), UKMTO reported another tanker struck by a projectile 50 nm west of Dubai (via @MenchOsint, https://x.com/i/status/2125733447713038447). US Under-Secretary of State Allison Hooker said she held "productive" talks with GCC leaders and Jordan and claimed coordinated action in the Strait is increasing pressure on Iran (Al Jazeera English, https://x.com/i/status/2125683925339209806). US envoy Jared Kushner said President Trump is keeping all options open on Iran and confirmed he has met Iranian officials (Al Jazeera English, https://x.com/i/status/2125756730600813014). Iranian officials' accounts relayed on the list reject US plans for a blockade (retweets of @araghchi and @ir_rezaee, https://x.com/i/status/2125656590699438102, https://x.com/i/status/2125656541336379481; Iranian government statements, reported as claims).

articles.headline: Poland asks NATO to study shooting down Russian missiles and drones over Ukraine
articles.summary: Poland has formally asked NATO to explore intercepting Russian drones and missiles over Ukraine when they are heading towards Alliance territory, after three Russian Kh-101 cruise missiles struck Poland last week (@sentdefender, https://x.com/i/status/2125795946369806648; image: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HYBYJYxXYAAJ9Zn.jpg; original source not cited, unverified).
articles.why: this would push NATO air defence beyond its borders for the first time. It is the most direct escalation debate on the eastern flank.

articles.headline: Ukraine war — ballistic strike on Kyiv; delays on US air-defence missiles
articles.summary: Russia launched a large ballistic missile attack on Ukraine late on 25 November, hitting a shopping centre in Kyiv and injuring three people (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125707526897561629). Zelensky said there was "no good news" from the US about speeding up deliveries of air-defence missiles (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125729185071268303, https://x.com/i/status/2125729242654912845). The US approved a possible Foreign Military Sale of F-16 sustainment for Ukraine worth an estimated $621.9 million (@Varsevan via @Schizointel, https://x.com/i/status/2125709796976312680; image: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HX_jv0qXwAAQf1I.jpg). One tally puts US security assistance under the second Trump administration at $8.49bn in FMS, $10bn through PURL, $700m in USAI and $300m in PDA (@Schizointel, https://x.com/i/status/2125711592473940326, unverified). More than 30 countries called on Russia to stop using toxic chemicals and riot-control agents as weapons of war in Ukraine (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125777287249383623).

articles.headline: Russia's war machine: refineries at a 20-year low, mass cheap cruise missiles, barriers against sea drones
articles.summary: Rystad Energy says Russian refinery runs have fallen to 2.6–2.7 million barrels a day, the lowest in more than two decades, as Ukraine keeps striking refineries (quoted by @RALee85, https://x.com/i/status/2125704548589170872; chart: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HYAE6ZlW8AALeYf.png). Rob Lee says Russia plans about 4,200 cheap cruise missiles in 2026 and aims for 30,000 next year (https://x.com/i/status/2125702447955898418). A Russian military channel reports that three Russian fleets now use floating barriers to keep Ukrainian sea drones out of their harbours (relayed by @Schizointel, https://x.com/i/status/2125730924084039714, unverified). Military Times reports estimates of more than 700,000 Russian soldiers killed, more than all US war deaths since the First World War (https://x.com/i/status/2125658763218620709, https://x.com/i/status/2125655876283351267).

articles.headline: Update: Iran war — Tehran says tankers hit mines in Hormuz and demands "coordinated" passage
articles.summary:
Iran's navy says a tanker hit a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire, after allegedly ignoring warnings and switching off its transponder (Al Jazeera English, https://x.com/i/status/2125607765234106736). Reuters reports Iran saying ships hit mines and warning vessels to coordinate their passage (https://x.com/i/status/2125620778058055951). The IRGC Navy spoke of two "rogue" tankers on fire and released drone footage (https://x.com/i/status/2125568864217936305). US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent claims Iran has not loaded a single oil tanker since Washington launched "Operation Economic Outcast" in August (Al Jazeera English, https://x.com/i/status/2125608823326945706). In Washington, CNN links October's inflation rise partly to the Iran war (via @atrupar, https://x.com/i/status/2125625301686276125).

**Background (CEAFE archive):** Mines in Hormuz are a recurring thread in the CEAFE archive: reports of Iran laying mines in the US-backed southern Omani corridor (27 Sep. 2026) and the IRGC Navy's claim that two supertankers caught fire after hitting mines in the southern strait (Al Jazeera, 19 Nov. 2026).
articles.why: a declared mine threat in Hormuz affects European energy supply and shipping insurance directly; Europe has no naval mine-countermeasure presence of its own there under a common flag.

articles.headline: Finland and Norway's back channel to Putin over the Baltic
articles.summary: Finnish President Alexander Stubb and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre reportedly sought to avert a military confrontation with Russia in the Baltic Sea, first using a Russian oligarch as an intermediary and then speaking directly with Putin on 27 October (@ClashReport citing a press report, https://x.com/i/status/2125651487149748343; original report not yet checked). Western intelligence officials say Moscow has reinforced Kaliningrad with drones, powerful radars and electronic-warfare equipment (relayed by @shashj, https://x.com/i/status/2125637622244442519), who also criticises allied signalling on a peacetime blockade (https://x.com/i/status/2125638552679588038).

articles.headline: Ukraine: first laser interception of a Russian jet-powered drone; port-blockade cost
articles.summary: Ukraine shot down a Russian jet-powered Shahed-type drone with a laser air-defence system for the first time, according to presidential adviser Serhiy "Flash" Beskrestnov (@ClashReport, https://x.com/i/status/2125619210600477164; Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125648797166624798). Fog and cloud over Kyiv had so far limited the system. A study cited by Kyiv Independent estimates a year-long blockade of Ukraine's three main Black Sea ports could cost $9.8 billion in 2027 (https://x.com/i/status/2125638345422508222). The EU backs Ukraine against the IAEA handing a lead role to a Russian (https://x.com/i/status/2125620853916230014), and Ukraine's parliament approved joining the management committee of the special tribunal on Russian aggression (https://x.com/i/status/2125620616292147242).

articles.headline: Update: Yemen and Gulf — strikes, Taiz fighting, Qatari condemnation
articles.summary: Qatar's cabinet condemned Houthi attacks on civilian and economic facilities in Saudi Arabia and Iranian attacks on a civilian industrial facility in Bahrain (Al Jazeera English, https://x.com/i/status/2125613246296277306). Yemeni government forces say they killed five Houthi fighters in artillery shelling in al-Aqroud, Taiz (https://x.com/i/status/2125637638971433002). Ansarallah repeated its warning to hit Saudi Red Sea ports if Hodeidah is bombed (@MenchOsint, https://x.com/i/status/2125567138437935273).

articles.headline: Israel, Iran and Lebanon
articles.summary: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi rejected Israeli accusations that Tehran is developing chemical weapons, accusing Israel of trying to drag the US into another war on Iran (Al Jazeera English, https://x.com/i/status/2125632253573419395). Iran condemned Israeli attacks on southern Lebanon (https://x.com/i/status/2125617486334722453). Israel killed Hamas's internal security chief and six others in Gaza City despite the ceasefire (https://x.com/i/status/2125622818133966976). Israel raises its defence budget by $5 billion (Breaking Defense, https://x.com/i/status/2125644247277658253).

articles.headline: Capabilities, industry and space with a war link
articles.summary: US Navy awards Raytheon an OTA for the developmental phase of the nuclear-armed sea-launched cruise missile SLCM-N (Janes, https://x.com/i/status/2125567778455261506). US Air Force awards Boeing $2.8 billion for more KC-46s (https://x.com/i/status/2125633457833267660). Russian defence firms seek production in China, potentially to evade sanctions (Atlantic Council / C4ADS, https://x.com/i/status/2125643209762107635). The Netherlands will buy two more NH90 naval helicopters to meet NATO targets (Naval Recognition, https://x.com/i/status/2125573699252167005). Japan assessed Indian ranges for anti-ship missile and drone training (Defense News, https://x.com/i/status/2125604445446693168). Space: The Economist on Starshield problems (via @shashj, https://x.com/i/status/2125583400178213272); Shenzhou-24 reached Tiangong in 3.5 hours (CGTN, Chinese state media, https://x.com/i/status/2125598473362055450). No new counter-space incident in this window.

articles.headline: Update: Yemen–Saudi war — Houthi drone strike hits Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery
articles.summary:
After the Saudi-led strikes on Hodeidah reported in the 08:30 edition, a drone launched from Yemen struck the Ras Tanura oil refinery and port terminal in the Eastern Province on the morning of 25 November, sending a large black plume over the site (video: @MenchOsint, https://x.com/i/status/2125534944340451328). The Saudi spokesman said only that "debris fell on the intended target"; the Houthis say they targeted the facility and the KAFD business district in Riyadh (https://x.com/i/status/2125513000966603127). Pro-Iranian accounts claim Ras Tanura supplies about 40% of Saudi domestic fuel (https://x.com/i/status/2125537495446155593; unverified). The strike came despite layered Patriot and fighter defences reportedly involving several partner air forces (https://x.com/i/status/2125525551871885756, OSINT commentary). Al Jazeera reports oil prices fell more than 1% on the day despite more tanker incidents (https://x.com/i/status/2125550387247616442).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Ras Tanura is one of the world's largest oil export hubs; a second energy front on top of Hormuz exposes Europe's dependence on Gulf supply routes and the limits of air defence against cheap long-range drones, a lesson for Europe's own critical infrastructure.

- **Key facts:** strike morning of 25 Nov (plume visible 09:15 UTC); distance from Yemen about 1,300 km (OSINT estimate).

- **Follow-up:** Saudi damage assessment and Aramco statement; Saudi retaliation in Yemen; Houthi claims against KAFD.

articles.headline: Ukraine claims hits on Russian MiG-31s and Su-34s at Savasleyka; Russian glide bombs on Odesa region
articles.summary:
Ukraine's General Staff claims hits on three MiG-31 and two Su-34 aircraft at Savasleyka air base in Nizhny Novgorod region (https://x.com/i/status/2125556277027967393; graphic: https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HX9-I-4boAAmnWB.png). OSINT watchers note the airfield has been under cloud on public satellite imagery for a month, so the presence of the aircraft could not be confirmed (https://x.com/i/status/2125557947271098797). Overnight, Russian Su-34s launched UMPK-guided glide bombs at the Odesa region from about 55 km, including on a substation in Artsyz (reposted by @GeromanAT from @MilitarySummary and @AMK_Mapping_, https://x.com/i/status/2125495282297115108, https://x.com/i/status/2125485424244101461). Russia claims the capture of Barvinkivka north-east of Orikhiv while DeepState confirms Russian advances elsewhere on the front (https://x.com/i/status/2125491182235013398), and Ukraine has extended the mandatory evacuation of families with children to all of Donetsk oblast (https://x.com/i/status/2125499823600087422).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Savasleyka hosts MiG-31s that carry Kinzhal missiles, the type used against Ukrainian cities and close to NATO borders; glide-bomb strikes on the Odesa coast threaten Ukraine's Black Sea export route to Europe.

- **Follow-up:** satellite confirmation of the Savasleyka damage; Russian strikes on Ukraine's grid.

articles.headline: Update: Ukraine's war at sea off Libya — Benghazi imagery and Italy's objection
articles.summary:
Satellite imagery of the port of Benghazi from 24 November shows the Mercury corvette almost completely submerged and the ro-ro vessel Angara damaged at the stern (ItaMilRadar, https://x.com/i/status/2125514213313442070). Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani said Ukraine should not attack Russian vessels off North Africa and opposed the spread of the war (via @MilitarySummary, https://x.com/i/status/2125501920521441737; original statement not yet checked). The BBC's Frank Gardner described the night attack as co-ordinated by Ukraine's SBU (repost, https://x.com/i/status/2125487842201624893).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** the war has reached the central Mediterranean, next to Italian and Maltese waters, and EU members are split on how to respond.

- **Follow-up:** Russian naval escort of the Sicily Channel convoy; Libyan (Haftar) reaction.

articles.headline: Italy tests Europe's sea-based ballistic missile defence and claims NATO spending target
articles.summary:
The Italian Navy says the frigate Giovanni delle Bande Nere intercepted a high-speed ballistic target with two Aster 30 missiles; La Repubblica called it Europe's only operational sea-based ballistic missile shield (@ClashReport, https://x.com/i/status/2125558870240079943). Separately, Italian officials say Rome reached defence and domestic-security spending of 2.8% of GDP in 2026, although the figure cannot be found in the defence budget itself (Defense News, https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/25/buried-in-italys-budget-officials-see-rome-meeting-nato-spending-target/).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Aster is a European missile (MBDA/Eurosam), so a successful naval ballistic intercept shows a home-grown alternative to US systems; the budget accounting shows how hard it is for one country to fund the effort alone.

- **Follow-up:** official Italian Navy release and test details; NATO spending figures.

articles.headline: Iran war: tighter Hormuz surveillance and crypto 'insurance' tolls
articles.summary:
Iran's army spokesman Mohammad Akraminia said the armed forces will surveil the Strait of Hormuz more strictly and warned that vessels attempting "unauthorised" transit face heightened risks (Al Jazeera, https://x.com/i/status/2125534866859278437). AGBI reports that ship owners pay Iran an "insurance" toll in cryptocurrency to cross the strait (https://www.agbi.com/analysis/shipping/2026/11/inside-irans-hormuz-toll-ships-pay-with-crypto-for-insurance/, via https://x.com/i/status/2125522144754855966). Al Jazeera also asks whether a new war with Iran could derail Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot's coalition talks (https://x.com/i/status/2125548360912257426).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a tolled strait run by Tehran raises shipping and energy costs for Europe and shows how sanctions can be bypassed with crypto payments.

- **Follow-up:** US response to the toll scheme; UKMTO advisories.

articles.headline: Capabilities and industry with a war link; space
articles.summary:
France's Navy has admitted De Grasse, the fourth Suffren-class nuclear attack submarine, into active service (Navy Recognition, https://www.armyrecognition.com/news/navy-news/2026/french-navy-admits-fourth-suffren-class-nuclear-attack-submarine-de-grasse-into-active-service). Czech jet-engine maker PBS Aerospace plans to at least double its production capacity in the United States for drones and missiles (Defense News, https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/25/czech-jet-engine-maker-eyes-growing-role-as-us-supplier-in-drones-missiles/). In space, the Shenzhou-24 crew, including astronauts from Pakistan, entered China's space station, and Xi Jinping and Asif Ali Zardari exchanged congratulations (CGTN, Chinese state media, https://x.com/i/status/2125527212128715197); no new satellite shadowing or proximity incident was reported in the window.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a European engine maker growing its capacity in the US rather than at home is another sign of the pull of the US market; China offers partners like Pakistan the human spaceflight cooperation Europe dropped when ESA left Tiangong plans.

articles.headline: Russia escalates pressure on the Baltic states: formal warning to Estonia, Latvia weighs border closure
articles.summary:
Russia's Foreign Ministry accused Estonia of hostile actions "on the verge of triggering open war", linking it to Ukrainian drone strikes; Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna dismissed the accusation as "Russian propaganda" (Reuters, https://x.com/i/status/2125409136120828129). Commentators describe it as Moscow's first formal warning to a NATO member of this kind (https://x.com/i/status/2125347552404856860). Latvia's Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs has asked ministries to assess restrictions on land crossings with Russia and present a position by next week, following Estonia's closure (https://x.com/i/status/2125319296007967132). Separately, Zelensky confirmed that Ukraine was responsible for the attack on the Russian cargo ship Sparta II in the Gulf of Finland (@FaytuksNetwork, https://x.com/i/status/2125432139831463941).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Russia is building a pretext against an EU and NATO member on the Baltic, while the war's maritime front reaches the Gulf of Finland, next to Finnish and Estonian waters.

- **What to watch:** Latvian government position next week; any Russian follow-up measures against Estonia; Finnish reaction after Helsinki summoned the Russian ambassador (previous edition).

**Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125409136120828129, https://x.com/i/status/2125347552404856860, https://x.com/i/status/2125319296007967132, https://x.com/i/status/2125432139831463941

articles.headline: Ukraine's deep strikes on Russian refineries and Russia's strikes on Ukraine
articles.summary:
A large Ukrainian drone raid hit Russia overnight on 25 November; monitoring channels report two oil refineries set ablaze, with Syzran and its refinery in the Volga basin among the targets (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125396503925535133; @OSINTtechnical, https://x.com/i/status/2125358622288855548). A Russian attack on Odesa Oblast killed two people, including a teenager, and a strike on a Kyiv residential courtyard injured two (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125369334335692849). A pro-Russian count claims at least 405 successful Russian strikes on Ukrainian railway infrastructure in 2026 (claim, https://x.com/i/status/2125446727893168631). The Russia-installed authorities in Donetsk claim a Ukrainian drone hit a bus station there (claim, https://x.com/i/status/2125439319967969667).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** the energy war hits both sides' winter resilience and keeps oil and gas prices high for Europe.

- **What to watch:** confirmation of the refineries hit; Russian retaliation against Ukraine's grid.

**Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125396503925535133, https://x.com/i/status/2125358622288855548, https://x.com/i/status/2125369334335692849, https://x.com/i/status/2125446727893168631, https://x.com/i/status/2125439319967969667

articles.headline: Update: Yemen–Saudi war — Hodeidah port struck after Houthi hit on Riyadh tower
articles.summary:
The Saudi-led coalition ordered civilians to evacuate Hodeidah port; the Houthis warned they would target Jeddah and other Saudi ports in return (Al Jazeera, https://x.com/i/status/2125388005955514515). Houthi-run Saba then reported coalition strikes on Hodeidah port and Hodeidah airport (https://x.com/i/status/2125364389347999863, https://x.com/i/status/2125397445760929929); video shows fires in the port (https://x.com/i/status/2125409052356379113), and @visegrad24 reports further Saudi strikes on the port this morning (https://x.com/i/status/2125466236330869197). Saba also reports a Saudi strike on vehicles in Lahj governorate leaving 25 people dead or missing (claim, https://x.com/i/status/2125379651438842341). The WSJ reports the Houthis hit Riyadh's Public Investment Fund tower for the second time in five days, injuring 11 (via https://x.com/i/status/2125426479609610484); India says two of its nationals were among the injured, and Qatar condemned the attack (Al Jazeera, https://x.com/i/status/2125470910975221926, https://x.com/i/status/2125341188391907612). The US Embassy in Jerusalem issued a region-wide alert over Houthi and Iranian threats (https://x.com/i/status/2125330492065288542).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a Saudi–Houthi war on the Red Sea coast threatens Suez traffic again and adds to the Hormuz disruption hitting European energy supply.

- **What to watch:** Houthi strikes on Saudi Red Sea ports; status of Saudi airspace.

**Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125388005955514515, https://x.com/i/status/2125364389347999863, https://x.com/i/status/2125397445760929929, https://x.com/i/status/2125409052356379113, https://x.com/i/status/2125466236330869197, https://x.com/i/status/2125379651438842341, https://x.com/i/status/2125426479609610484, https://x.com/i/status/2125470910975221926, https://x.com/i/status/2125341188391907612, https://x.com/i/status/2125330492065288542

articles.headline: Iran war: funding, blockade and the Hormuz front
articles.summary:
Trump told the New York Post that funding for US operations against Iran is secured through the end of January 2027 and warned Democrats not to turn a "total win" into a loss when they take control of Congress (Al Jazeera, https://x.com/i/status/2125412908083638363). A poll cited by Al Jazeera finds 55% of US voters want the war to end immediately, regardless of terms (https://x.com/i/status/2125439333532676209). Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei called US blockade plans "delusional and futile" (Iranian claim, https://x.com/i/status/2125351720951947472). Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz says Iran is developing chemical weapons (claim, via https://x.com/i/status/2125322976988114972). @ClashReport shared footage reportedly showing a US/Israeli strike on an Iran Air Airbus at Bushehr at the start of the war (unverified, https://x.com/i/status/2125336301016584481).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a war funded at least into 2027 keeps Hormuz risk, energy prices and US munitions demand high, competing with European and Ukrainian needs.

- **What to watch:** US confirmation or denial of the MQ-9 loss; blockade measures.

**Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125412908083638363, https://x.com/i/status/2125439333532676209, https://x.com/i/status/2125351720951947472, https://x.com/i/status/2125322976988114972, https://x.com/i/status/2125336301016584481

articles.headline: Ukraine war at sea off Libya: Haftar forces count losses, Italy alarmed
articles.summary:
Haftar's Libyan Arab Armed Forces announced that a navy officer and an NCO were killed in the Ukrainian attack on Benghazi port, and vowed revenge (https://x.com/i/status/2125348519754047918). The Financial Times count, relayed on the list, puts 16 major Russian naval vessels struck since 2022 (8 lost, 8 severely damaged) (https://x.com/i/status/2125351277727256977). Italy has voiced concern that the war is spreading into the Mediterranean (https://x.com/i/status/2125433342262644806).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Naval combat in the central Mediterranean brings the Ukraine war to the EU's southern flank, near Italy and Malta.

- **What to watch:** movements of the Russian convoy in the Sicily Channel (Early warning).

**Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125348519754047918, https://x.com/i/status/2125351277727256977, https://x.com/i/status/2125433342262644806

articles.headline: Counter-space and space: US proliferated military constellations; Shenzhou-24 docks
articles.summary:
Jonathan McDowell lists the US military constellations now being deployed, including the Space Force's SDN R communications and SDN TH radar satellites, the Space Development Agency's missile trackers and the NRO's proliferated architecture with at least two sub-series (https://x.com/i/status/2125382900220645768). China's Shenzhou-24 crewed spacecraft launched and docked with the Tiangong station on 25 November, according to the China Manned Space Agency (state media, CGTN, https://x.com/i/status/2125441789608014257). No new satellite shadowing or proximity incident was reported in this window.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** the US and China are scaling military space while Europe's own constellations (IRIS²) are still years away.

**Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125382900220645768, https://x.com/i/status/2125441789608014257

articles.headline: Defence contracts with a war link
articles.summary:
Boeing has a US Air Force contract for 15 more KC-46A tankers (203 on contract or in service worldwide) (@defpostmedia, https://x.com/i/status/2125460346253307915). Elbit Systems Deutschland will supply integrated naval electronic warfare suites for the German Navy's F-128 frigates (https://x.com/i/status/2125469419241426958), and Thales will deliver STAR NG and RSM NG radars to the Royal Netherlands Air and Space Force (https://x.com/i/status/2125465960060698831).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** an Israeli group's German subsidiary wins EW on a German frigate, while a European supplier (Thales) equips a European air force.

**Sources:** https://x.com/i/status/2125460346253307915, https://x.com/i/status/2125469419241426958, https://x.com/i/status/2125465960060698831

articles.headline: Update: Iran war — Hormuz attack count revised; Katz says a strike decision rests with Trump, as Netanyahu presses for action
articles.summary:
The Hormuz picture worsened in the afternoon. UKMTO has reclassified Sunday's (22 November) warning: three vessels sailing eastbound through the strait were struck at the same time, around 20:50 UTC (21:50 Madrid), and are now counted as three separate incidents (@sentdefender, https://x.com/i/status/2125276448261042466). They are reported to be the Sinokor-owned tankers *Cameroon Prosperity*, *Bahrain Prosperity* and *Romania Prosperity* (https://x.com/i/status/2125287958940946927). Iran says four more tankers exploded after hitting mines east of the strait (Iranian claim; identities not released), and Tehran's Persian Gulf Strait Authority added 26 tugs and offshore support vessels to its "non-compliance list" for servicing US-backed shipping (@visegrad24, https://x.com/i/status/2125259883482357917).

On the political side, Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz said Iran is developing chemical weapons, that the IDF and US CENTCOM are preparing for possible strikes and that the decision rests with President Trump; he also claimed Iranian cells inside the US are targeting Trump and his family. Israel's public broadcaster Kan reported that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is pressing Trump to strike "as soon as possible" (The Independent), while Ynet reports a split: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir sees no immediate threat requiring a strike and Mossad director Roman Gofman favours acting sooner; Haaretz's editorial says Netanyahu "keeps finding pretexts for his political survival". Clash Report says Trump administration officials are debating whether to assassinate senior Iranian leaders (unverified; no primary source given). Qatar urged Washington and Tehran to show restraint (Al Jazeera, Euronews). Iran says it has filed lawsuits in US and European courts over alleged war crimes, including a missile strike on a school that killed at least 178 people (Iranian figure via Al Jazeera), and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi accused the US of "crippling" the OPCW. A Knesset committee approved about NIS 17.3 billion in extra 2026 defence spending (Katz).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a resumed US–Israeli air campaign would hit European energy prices and shipping again, while European courts may now be drawn into the war's legal fallout. The EU has no seat in these decisions.

- **What to watch:** whether Trump authorises strikes; identities of the mined tankers; insurers' response to Iran's expanded list.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125276448261042466), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125226534281629951), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125287958940946927), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125259883482357917), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125262215154377181), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125278131795693957), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125284201293337055), [The Independent](https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/netanyahu-trump-strike-iran-israel-war-b3089829.html), [Ynet](https://www.ynetnews.com/article/ry4zdsf17e), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125216648634265931), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125265100831387921), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125268275013767641), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125249751910420912), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125281057419522509), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/features/2026/11/24/irans-fight-for-wartime-redress-moves-from-battlefield-to-us-eu-courts), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125276099177279683), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125240074606448743)

articles.headline: Update: Yemen–Saudi war — PIF tower in Riyadh hit; Jizan damage confirmed by satellite
articles.summary:
A projectile from Yemen hit a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District, identified as the Public Investment Fund (PIF) tower; Saudi state media published a photo of the damage and Saudi Civil Defence reported 11 injured (via Anadolu). @MenchOsint notes that the Saudi-led coalition spokesman admitted a direct hit, without the usual wording about falling debris, that witnesses heard a loud boom without any civil-defence alert, and that it is the third time a tower in the district has been struck.

Sentinel-2 imagery confirms impacts at the Shuqaiq power station and at Jizan port, where a large warehouse was hit (claims first reported in the 14:30 edition). Clash Report says Riyadh has asked the US, the UK, France and others for more interceptors; France 24 reports that Houthi fighters are closing in on Aden. Pro-Houthi accounts report Saudi airstrikes in Sana'a (unverified). Rashad al-Alimi, head of Yemen's Presidential Leadership Council, said government forces can defeat the Houthis and reunify the country. From the CEAFE archive: as early as February 2022, the UAE, then reeling from Houthi attacks, was seeking advanced Israeli radar (Breaking Defense).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** strikes on Saudi energy and financial sites add risk for Red Sea shipping and oil supply on top of the Hormuz crisis, and Gulf partners are now turning to European suppliers, among others, for air defence.

- **What to watch:** Saudi retaliation in Sana'a; whether Riyadh's air-defence warnings failed; replies to the interceptor requests.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125221709959594491), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125246605515182396), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125226020714213871), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125234776877445523), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125251958315327665), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125203525521023420), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125243873962107377), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125272039359676493), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125241941969293408), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125287439363412171), [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2022/02/uae-reeling-from-houthi-attacks-seeking-israeli-advanced-radar-sources/)

articles.headline: Ukraine's war at sea: Putin vows retaliation for attacks on Russian ships
articles.summary:
Vladimir Putin said Russia will retaliate for Ukrainian attacks on its vessels and accused Kyiv of continuing to strike Russian refineries despite a direct request from President Trump (Al Jazeera). Zelensky defended Saturday's drone strike on the Russian cargo ship *Sparta II* in the Gulf of Finland: "We did everything right", he told US media and Bloomberg.

On Libya, Kyiv insists the attack on Russian ships at Benghazi was self-defence (Reuters). Al Jazeera notes that Ukraine is taking its fight against Russia beyond Europe, from Libya to Sudan and Mali.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** a strike in the Gulf of Finland and a vow of retaliation bring the maritime war into NATO's northern waters, between EU member states Finland and Estonia.

- **What to watch:** the form of any Russian retaliation; Baltic shipping security.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125260442037834146), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125256040136810872), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125284605649359347), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125276065056870586)

articles.headline: North-eastern and Black Sea flank: Finland summons Russia's ambassador; Romanian disclosure on Neptun Deep
articles.summary:
Finland, an EU member state and NATO member, summoned Russia's ambassador over Moscow's recent actions in Europe, including a violation of Finnish airspace by a Russian military helicopter on Saturday 21 November (@FaytuksNetwork). Former Romanian defence minister Radu Miruță said Russia declared a no-fly zone over the Neptun Deep gas project in Romania's exclusive economic zone on 20 August and threatened to strike Romanian jets; Romania sent an F-16 anyway, which destroyed a naval drone, and Russia did not respond.

In the Mediterranean, Italy's offshore patrol vessel (PPA) *Giovanni delle Bande Nere* intercepted its first ballistic target with Aster 30 missiles (Army Recognition). ItaMilRadar tracked an Italian Air Force P-72A on a SIGINT mission over Bosnia and Herzegovina for EU Operation Althea and a Portuguese P-3 patrolling the central Mediterranean.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Russian pressure is growing around EU energy infrastructure in the Black Sea, and the Aster interception shows European-made ballistic-missile defence at sea.

- **What to watch:** Bucharest's official confirmation of the August episode; Moscow's reply to Helsinki.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125212441328161013), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125227570153082960), [Army Recognition](https://www.armyrecognition.com/news/navy-news/2026/italys-ppa-giovanni-delle-bande-nere-warship-intercepts-first-ballistic-target-with-aster-30-missiles), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125210101384442348), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125274566297616629)

articles.headline: Update: counter-space — Russian nuclear satellite could launch "within 60 days", German report says
articles.summary:
German broadcasters WDR and NDR and the Süddeutsche Zeitung report an early-November intelligence assessment that Russia could launch "within 60 days", by the end of the year, a nuclear-armed satellite dubbed "Sputnik-S", said to have been stored near Moscow for years (Defense News). Asked in Berlin, NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte said the Alliance will defend "every inch of NATO territory", including "the space element".

Placing nuclear weapons in orbit is banned by the 1967 Outer Space Treaty, to which Russia is a party; a detonation in orbit could disable many satellites and damage power grids through its electromagnetic pulse.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** European military and civil satellites would be exposed; the report ties in with the 2024 US warnings on a Russian nuclear anti-satellite programme.

- **What to watch:** official German and US comment; launches from Plesetsk and Baikonur.

**Sources:** [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/11/24/russia-may-launch-nuke-laden-satellite-by-years-end-german-report-warns/), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125211904536723929)

articles.headline: Indo-Pacific: PLA Navy group transits the Osumi Strait; Taiwan's submarine on its 26th sea trial
articles.summary:
Japan's Joint Staff Office reports that four PLA Navy ships, the Type 055 destroyer *Lhasa* (102), the Type 052D *Xining* (117), the Type 054A *Yancheng* (546) and a Type 903A replenishment ship, transited the Osumi Strait westbound into the East China Sea on 24 November.

Taiwan's first domestically built submarine, *Hai Kun* (711), left Kaohsiung for its 26th sea trial, including submerged tests.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** routine PLA transits near Japan and Taiwan's push for its own submarines keep the Taiwan Strait, a key route for European trade, at the centre of regional tension.

- **What to watch:** the PLA group's onward route; results of *Hai Kun*'s submerged trials.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125279026105262325), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125263286312558801)

articles.headline: US: Golden Dome and the "Trump battleship" in the funding stopgap
articles.summary:
The White House is seeking funding exemptions for the Golden Dome missile-defence programme and the planned battleship in the next stopgap budget (Breaking Defense).

US Representative Thomas Massie separately criticised talk of a "$350 billion emergency military supplemental" for Gaza and Iran.

- **Why it matters for Europe:** Washington protects its own flagship defence programmes even under stopgap budgets, while Europeans still debate how to fund theirs.

- **What to watch:** whether Congress grants the exemptions in the next continuing resolution.

**Sources:** [Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/11/white-house-seeks-funding-exemptions-for-golden-dome-trump-battleship-in-next-funding-stopgap/), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125221943767179707)

articles.headline: Update: Iran war — more tanker fires in Hormuz, bulk carrier hit off the UAE; Tehran orders a tighter blockade
articles.summary:
Iran says two more oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz; Al Jazeera notes the claims have not been independently verified (https://x.com/i/status/2125161737288548511). The IRGC Navy speaks of a fourth “violating” tanker on fire (via https://x.com/i/status/2125186466922004933), and satellite fire detections support at least one ship fire overnight and another in the morning (satellite fire detections). UKMTO separately reports a bulk carrier hit by an unknown projectile at anchor 23 nautical miles north-east of Khor Fakkan (https://x.com/i/status/2125146633188806713). According to Iranian reports, the chief of the regular army (Artesh) ordered the navy commander to tighten the blockade of the strait “day by day” until Washington accepts Tehran’s terms (@IranObserver0, https://x.com/i/status/2125174346972889596). Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said a land blockade of Iran is “virtually impossible” given its size (Iranian state media via Al Jazeera, https://x.com/i/status/2125157475120759287). Despite this, oil fell to three-month lows as rising supply offsets the Hormuz threat (Reuters, https://x.com/i/status/2125191480377561326). On the cyber front, the US Coast Guard has deployed cyber teams after attacks on up to 50 energy tankers (@ClashReport, https://x.com/i/status/2125157229712060513).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** the threat now reaches ships waiting off the UAE, outside the strait itself, raising insurance and freight costs for Europe’s energy imports.

- **Follow-up:** UKMTO details on the Khor Fakkan vessel; names and flags of the burning tankers; any US response to the blockade order.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125161737288548511), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125186466922004933), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125146633188806713), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125174346972889596), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125157475120759287), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125191480377561326), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125157229712060513)

articles.headline: Ukraine war: 355 drones toward Moscow; Russian strikes kill 9; Western parts in Russian drones
articles.summary:
Moscow mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 355 drones flew towards the capital between 23:00 on 23 November and 08:00 on 24 November (relayed via https://x.com/i/status/2125172938185789689); Russia’s Defence Ministry claims 699 Ukrainian drones were shot down overnight over Russian regions and the Black Sea (claim relayed via https://x.com/i/status/2125126375313215925). Russian attacks killed 9 people and injured 77 across Ukraine over the past day; in Zaporizhzhia Oblast a five-storey residential building was partly destroyed, killing two and injuring 44 (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125194936035238171), and Zelensky said Russian strikes focused on energy in the Zhytomyr region (reposted by @F_CEAFE). A Ukrainian intelligence report seen by the Kyiv Independent finds US and European components in a Geran-4 jet drone shot down in August; 12 parts carry dates, all made in 2024–2026 (https://x.com/i/status/2125130441258684535). @OSINTtechnical shows the R-280 highway, a key Russian supply route in the occupied south, littered with destroyed trucks (https://x.com/i/status/2125175908038254835). A Guardian analysis of leaked Rosstat records lists 1,087 Russian military suicides since the start of the Ukraine war (@ClashReport, https://x.com/i/status/2125171316638753135).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** European components still reach Russian drones despite sanctions, a sanctions-enforcement issue for the EU.

- **Follow-up:** damage assessment around Moscow; the new EU sanctions package (topic 6).

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125172938185789689), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125126375313215925), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125194936035238171), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125130441258684535), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125175908038254835), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125171316638753135)

articles.headline: North-eastern flank: Geran-5 in Poland, Russian build-up near Finland, Sarmat
articles.summary:
The drone that entered Poland on the night of 23–24 November is now described by independent analysts as a jet-powered Geran-5 that reached about 25 km into Polish territory (Update; https://x.com/i/status/2125131447254106462). Yle reports Russia is modernising a base near the Finnish border for up to 11,000 troops (https://x.com/i/status/2125172958024835478), and Latvia is reportedly considering closing its border with Russia (unverified, https://x.com/i/status/2125125375529287688). IISS says the Sarmat heavy ICBM may have begun entering service (https://x.com/i/status/2125152951849070740). NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte called on member states to prepare society as a whole for the risk of war with Russia (relayed via https://x.com/i/status/2125184097974628762).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** jet drones are faster and harder to intercept than Shaheds; the Finnish-border build-up will define NATO’s newest front.

- **Follow-up:** Polish debris or radar data; Finnish Defence Forces comment on the Yle report.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125131447254106462), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125172958024835478), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125125375529287688), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125152951849070740), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125184097974628762)

articles.headline: Update: Libya — Kyiv calls the Benghazi strikes self-defence; imagery confirms the *Angara*
articles.summary:
Ukraine’s Foreign Ministry spokesman Heorhii Tykhyi said the strikes on Russian ships in Libya were lawful self-defence, arguing that “the threat to Libya was created precisely by Russian warships and Russian arms carriers” (Kyiv Independent, https://x.com/i/status/2125185563741295039). OSINT imagery confirms the cargo ship hit near Benghazi was the Ro-Ro *Angara* (via @FaytuksNetwork, https://x.com/i/status/2125166566157562165). Libyan authorities condemned the attacks (CGTN, state media, https://x.com/i/status/2125122246595207224). Unverified aggregator claims say an Iranian vessel, *Alvan*, was also hit by naval drones off Libya (https://x.com/i/status/2125127769466040334), and that Albania denied drones were launched from its territory (https://x.com/i/status/2125126659418554801).

- **Why it matters for Europe:** the naval war now touches the central Mediterranean, Libya’s politics and, through rumours, NATO members such as Albania.

- **Follow-up:** confirmation or denial of the *Alvan* report; Tripoli and LNA positions.

**Sources:** [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125185563741295039), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125166566157562165), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125122246595207224), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125127769466040334), [X](https://x.com/i/status/2125126659418554801)

articles.headline: Yemen–Saudi war: Houthis claim 11th Wing Loong-2; UK sanctions

Yemen’s Ansarallah (Houthis) say they shot down another Saudi-operated Wing Loong-2 drone over Lahj governorate, the eleventh since the escalation began (@MenchOsint, https://x.com/i/status/2125154806079594778). Pro-Houthi accounts claim damage at the Shuqaiq power station in Jizan after a Yemeni attack (via https://x.com/i/status/2125198550522806468). Both are unverified, partisan claims. The UK announced sanctions on the Houthis for undermining stability in the Middle East and on four senior officials over human rights abuses (via @FaytuksNetwork, https://x.com/i/status/2125193504695705936).

- **Follow-up:** Saudi confirmation; damage at Shuqaiq, a major power and desalination site.

articles.headline: Update: Iran war — IRGC says three tankers under US escort hit mines in Hormuz; Iran vows “all tools” against the blockade
articles.summary:
Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps says three “non-compliant” oil tankers sailing under US aerial escort suffered “severe explosions and fire” after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz; the Iranian Navy said the US escort “was unable to prevent these incidents” and promised images (Al Jazeera). These are Iranian claims; no US confirmation was found in the window. Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said Iran will use “all the tools” at its disposal against the US naval blockade, which it calls aggression, while Tehran also said security in the strait could be restored quickly if the US met its conditions. On the diplomatic track, Axios reports that Vice President JD Vance met Qatar’s Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani on the Iran negotiations, and Qatar says it continues to work on de-escalation. Separately, the WSJ reports that the US is investigating cyberattacks on up to 50 ships, some with bomb threats, with Iran and Russia as possible suspects; the US says it has no evidence of Iranian involvement (Reuters; Al Jazeera). The IRGC also says it has shot down its 58th MQ-9.

**Context:** Antecedentes: the Strait of Hormuz has been blockaded since the spring of 2026; on 17 April 2026 @F_CEAFE commented on President Emmanuel Macron's announcement that France, alongside more than fifty countries, was leading an initiative for freedom of navigation in the strait ([X, 2026](https://x.com/i/status/2045202134480638071)).

**What to watch:** US confirmation or denial of the mine hits; tanker names and flags; UKMTO advisories.

**Sources:** [X (1)](https://x.com/i/status/2124984786498281551), [X (2)](https://x.com/i/status/2125080719227494502), [X (3)](https://x.com/i/status/2124983403749466497), [X (4)](https://x.com/i/status/2124994660905218223), [X (5)](https://x.com/i/status/2125026612714319920), [X (6)](https://x.com/i/status/2125004055013392481), [X (7)](https://x.com/i/status/2125050893733154952), [X (8)](https://x.com/i/status/2125082018589368516), [X (9)](https://x.com/i/status/2125088850083295612), [X (10)](https://x.com/i/status/2125018031248347478)
articles.why: mines and cyberattacks on merchant shipping raise insurance and energy costs for Europe and test whether escorts alone can keep the strait open.

articles.headline: Poland and Moldova: Russian drone violates Polish airspace days after missile incursion
articles.summary:
A Russian one-way attack drone briefly entered Polish airspace during the overnight attack on western Ukraine; Polish air defence was activated and air-raid sirens sounded near Lublin (@visegrad24). It follows the Kh-101 debris found at three Polish sites last week. In Moldova, local media report a drone burst into flames after crashing in the Russian-occupied Transnistria region on the evening of 23 November (Kyiv Independent).

**What to watch:** Polish government statement on debris; any NATO Article 4 request; confirmation of AWACS forward deployment.

**Sources:** [X (1)](https://x.com/i/status/2124991594957009253), [X (2)](https://x.com/i/status/2125003063308251529), [X (3)](https://x.com/i/status/2125058619175510306)
articles.why: repeated incursions test NATO’s eastern air defence and its rules of engagement.

articles.headline: Russian warplanes near Ulleung: South Korea orders residents to shelter and scrambles F-15Ks; Seoul will protest to Moscow
articles.summary:
At 07:52 local time on Tuesday (23:52 Madrid on Monday), South Korea's interior ministry ordered residents of Ulleung island to take shelter underground after several Russian military aircraft entered the Korea Air Defence Identification Zone (KADIZ) over the East Sea (Sea of Japan). The alert was lifted about five minutes later. The Joint Chiefs of Staff said the aircraft came "to the point just before violating" the island's airspace and then left; there was no violation. F-15Ks were scrambled before the aircraft entered the zone. A provincial message wrongly called them "suspected North Korean aircraft" and was corrected later. The defence ministry will summon a Russian embassy official to lodge a formal complaint (Yonhap, JoongAng Daily, The Guardian). In Brussels the previous week, Japan's State Minister of Defence Odawara told the EU Schuman Security and Defence Forum that Euro-Atlantic and Indo-Pacific security are "inseparable".

**What to watch:** Russia's response to Seoul's protest; any joint Russia–China air patrol pattern (previous ones have crossed the KADIZ); Japanese reports of the same flight.

**Sources:** [Yonhap](https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20261124002251315), [Korea JoongAng Daily](https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/korea/russian-aircraft-prompt-brief-ulleung-air-raid-warning-alert-mistakenly-identifies-them-as-north-korean/12987159), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/24/south-korea-tells-island-residents-to-take-shelter-after-russian-military-aircraft-approach), [Reuters](https://x.com/i/status/2125074478786846973), [dpa](https://x.com/i/status/2125103119046426829), [Japan MoD (Odawara at the Schuman Forum)](https://x.com/i/status/2125098507589779512)
articles.why: the pattern of Russian probes now runs from Poland and the Baltic to the Korean peninsula. The same pressure on air-defence systems and public nerves that Poland, Finland and Estonia faced last week now appears on the far side of Eurasia. It reinforces the case for Europe to build its own airspace-surveillance and air-defence capabilities, rather than relying on others' alert systems.

articles.headline: Yemen–Saudi war: launches from Yemen toward southern Saudi Arabia
articles.summary:
**Pro-Houthi accounts report missile and drone launches from Yemen with Saudi air defences active in the south, and flights to Jeddah and Dammam placed in holding patterns (@MenchOsint; video via). The same accounts accuse Saudi Arabia of new strikes on civilians in Yemen. These are unverified, partisan sources; no Saudi official confirmation was found in the window.**

**What to watch:** Saudi coalition statement; GACA flight notices.

**Sources:** [X (1)](https://x.com/i/status/2124964288821436526), [X (2)](https://x.com/i/status/2124989938844246140), [X (3)](https://x.com/i/status/2124942788638781675)
